title.en: Revisiting Over-refusal in Safety-aligned Large Language Models: A Representation and Optimization Perspective
title.zh: 重新审视安全对齐模型的过度拒答：表征与优化视角

summary.en: GOAL combines gradient orthogonalization and contrastive representation learning to improve the boundary between harmful and benign risky-looking requests.
summary.zh: GOAL 结合梯度正交化与对比表征学习，改善有害请求与表面敏感良性请求之间的边界。

papers.authors: Chen Chao, Shao Pengyang, Qin Wei, Hao Shijie, Shen Fei, Hong Richang

title.en: Two interventions in the learning process
title.zh: 学习过程中的两类干预

explanation.en: GOAL combines refusal-subspace gradient projection with safety-aware contrastive learning.
explanation.zh: GOAL 结合拒答子空间梯度投影与安全感知对比学习。

title.zh: 分析梯度耦合

explanation.zh: 原始分析比较不同样本组的低秩集中程度与梯度方向对齐。

The best results within each model block are shown in bold, and the second-best results are underlined.

title.zh: 校准需要联合评估

explanation.en: The table compares over-refusal, harmful-request safety, and general-capability measurements across three models.
explanation.zh: 原表在三个模型上同时比较过度拒答、安全防护及一般能力。

en.thesis: Accurate safety labels need an optimization process that preserves the distinction they are meant to teach.
short: This work asks why harmless requests can still be refused after safety training with correct supervision. It examines two interacting observations: harmful and over-refusal representations become less distinguishable at deeper layers, while harmful-sample gradients concentrate in a low-rank subspace and align more strongly with refusal-target updates.

GOAL responds at both levels. It projects over-refusal gradients away from the harmful-gradient refusal subspace and uses a contrastive objective to strengthen representational separation. The method connects a diagnosis of training dynamics to a targeted change in how the model learns the safety boundary.
en.motivation: Correctly labeling a benign request does not ensure that its desired update will be preserved during joint training. Understanding over-refusal requires examining how examples interact through both their representations and the gradients that change the model.
method: Estimate a low-rank refusal subspace from harmful-sample gradients.
Orthogonalize over-refusal gradients relative to that subspace to reduce conflicting update components.
Combine the gradient intervention with contrastive learning that separates harmful and over-refusal representations.
en.evidence: Representation visualizations and gradient analyses motivate the two components. Experiments across three base models compare GOAL with alignment and over-refusal baselines using joint measures of over-refusal, harmful-request safety, and general capabilities. Component ablations and subspace-sensitivity analyses test the proposed design.
takeaway: The study treats calibration as a property of the learning process, alongside the data supplied to it. Even well-supervised examples can interact in ways that erode a useful boundary, so improving safety may require controlling the geometry of those interactions.

This perspective links behavior to two testable targets: what distinctions remain visible internally, and which directions training updates reinforce. Evaluating both helps explain why a method changes refusal patterns, while joint safety and utility measurements establish whether the resulting calibration is useful.
en.deck: GOAL combines gradient orthogonalization and contrastive representation learning to improve the boundary between harmful and benign risky-looking requests.

zh.thesis: 准确的安全标签，还需要学习过程保留这些标签试图建立的区分。
short: 这项工作追问：即使安全监督正确，良性请求为何仍可能被拒答？研究结合两类观察展开：有害与过度拒答样本的深层表征更难区分，同时有害样本梯度集中于低秩子空间，并更强地与拒答目标的更新方向对齐。
GOAL 分别作用于这两个层面：将过度拒答梯度中沿有害梯度拒答子空间的成分移除，并通过对比目标增强表征区分。由此，训练动态诊断被连接到安全边界学习方式的具体修改。
zh.motivation: 为良性请求提供正确标签，并不意味着联合训练会完整保留它所需要的更新。理解过度拒答，还需要考察样本如何通过表征及改变模型的梯度相互影响。
method: 利用有害样本梯度，估计低秩拒答子空间。
相对于该子空间正交化过度拒答梯度，减少冲突更新成分。
结合对比学习，增强有害与过度拒答样本的表征区分。
zh.evidence: 表征可视化与梯度分析为两个模块提供动机。实验在三个基础模型上，将 GOAL 与对齐及过度拒答基线比较，联合考察过度拒答、有害请求防护和一般能力，并通过模块消融及子空间敏感性分析检验设计。
takeaway: 这项研究把校准视为学习过程的性质，并与数据监督共同考察。即使每个样本的目标正确，样本之间的更新交互也可能侵蚀有效边界，因此安全改进需要进一步控制这些交互的几何关系。
这一视角将行为连接到两个可检验目标：哪些区分在内部仍然可见，训练又持续增强了哪些方向。联合观察二者，有助于解释拒答模式为何变化；安全与帮助性的共同评估，则检验这种校准是否真正有用。
zh.deck: GOAL 结合梯度正交化与对比表征学习，改善有害请求与表面敏感良性请求之间的边界。

title.en: Safety Kernel: Mechanistic Alignment for Cross-Lingual Defense in LLMs
title.zh: Safety Kernel：面向跨语言防御的机制驱动安全对齐

summary.en: A compact cross-language safety kernel supplies shared FFN coordinates for mechanistic diagnosis and masked LoRA adaptation.
summary.zh: 以紧凑的跨语言安全核心，连接机制诊断与限定 FFN 坐标的 LoRA 适配。

papers.authors: Xie Chengyu, Shen Fei, Miao Shuyi, Feng Yue, Yu Jian, Shao Pengyang, Tian Yijun, Du Xiaoyu

figures.caption: Figure 2: Overview of the proposed framework. (a) Language-wise safety-neuron sets are identified using SCAR scores computed from activation differences between unsafe and safe prompts, and their cross-lingual intersection forms the SK. (b) The functional relevance of the SK is examined through neuron activation suppression and cross-lingual safety-state transfer. (c) SK-Masked LoRA restricts fine-tuning-induced output changes to the SK coordinates for multilingual safety adaptation.

title.en: From kernel discovery to masked adaptation
title.zh: 从核心发现到受限适配

explanation.en: The framework connects language-wise scoring, shared-set validation, and SK-guided LoRA updates.
explanation.zh: 框架连接逐语言评分、共享集合验证与安全核心引导的 LoRA 更新。

figures.caption: Figure 3: Activation-state intervention through SK neurons on MultiJail. The safety activation state is estimated from English and Chinese safe refusals and transferred to the target languages. Lower ASR indicates better safety.

title.zh: 改变安全核心的激活状态

explanation.en: Safety outcomes are compared after transferring a refusal-related activation state through kernel coordinates.
explanation.zh: 比较通过核心坐标迁移拒答相关激活状态后的安全表现。

figures.caption: Table 3: Comparison of ASR (%, ↓) on AdvBench-x and MultiJail. Results are shown for two backbones. The best results are highlighted in bold, while the second-best results are underlined.

title.zh: 跨语言防御结果

explanation.en: The original table compares attack success rates across languages and alignment baselines.
explanation.zh: 原表比较不同语言和对齐基线下的攻击成功率。

en.thesis: Cross-language alignment can be organized around a shared internal target whose behavior is tested before tuning.
short: Safety Kernel identifies a compact set of safety-related neuron coordinates shared across languages. SCAR scores combine activation responsiveness and safety contrast on parallel safe and unsafe prompts; intersecting the language-wise candidate sets produces the kernel.

Suppression and activation-state transfer test its functional relevance. SK-Masked LoRA then restricts adaptation to the corresponding FFN output dimensions, linking the diagnosed shared mechanism to a specific parameter-update scope.
en.motivation: External alignment supervision can improve multilingual safety without revealing which internal computation transfers the behavior. A common mechanistic target would help connect the languages used for discovery, the coordinates changed by training, and the languages used for evaluation.
method: Compute language-wise SCAR scores from multilingual parallel safe and unsafe prompts.
Intersect candidate neuron sets and test the kernel with suppression and activation-state transfer.
Constrain LoRA adaptation to the selected FFN output dimensions and evaluate cross-language defense and capability retention.
en.evidence: The study combines compactness measurements, masking tests, and activation-state interventions across model backbones. Safety comparisons include languages excluded from kernel discovery, alongside analyses of selection scope, update scope, kernel composition, and general capabilities.
takeaway: The framework creates a clearer chain from observation to control: identify a shared set, test what changing it does, and tune within its coordinates. This makes multilingual transfer more interpretable than a performance improvement considered without an internal account.

The kernel is defined by the discovery procedure and language set, rather than being an unconditional property of every model. Studying its composition and held-out transfer helps establish when a compact shared target is a useful basis for intervention.
en.deck: A compact cross-language safety kernel supplies shared FFN coordinates for mechanistic diagnosis and masked LoRA adaptation.

zh.thesis: 跨语言对齐可以围绕一个共享内部目标组织，并在微调前先检验其行为作用。
short: Safety Kernel 识别跨语言共享的紧凑安全神经元坐标集合。SCAR 评分结合平行良性与有害提示上的激活响应及安全对比，再将各语言候选集合求交，得到安全核心。
抑制与激活状态迁移实验用于检验其功能作用。随后，SK-Masked LoRA 将适配限制在这些坐标对应的 FFN 输出维度，使机制诊断能够直接约束参数更新范围。
zh.motivation: 外部监督能够改善多语言安全，却未必揭示安全行为通过哪些内部计算发生迁移。共同的机制目标，有助于连接用于发现的语言、训练修改的位置，以及最终接受评估的语言。
method: 使用多语言平行良性与有害提示，计算各语言的 SCAR 评分。
对候选神经元集合求交，并通过抑制与激活状态迁移检验安全核心。
将 LoRA 适配限定在选定 FFN 输出维度，联合评估跨语言防护与能力保留。
zh.evidence: 论文结合紧凑性测量、屏蔽与激活状态干预，并在防御比较中纳入未参与核心发现的语言。其他分析进一步考察选择与更新范围、核心的语言组成和一般能力变化。
takeaway: 这一框架建立了较清楚的观察—控制链条：先识别共享集合，检验改变它会产生什么影响，再沿其坐标进行适配。多语言迁移因此能够连接到内部解释，而不仅体现为一次分数提升。
安全核心由发现过程与语言集合定义。研究其组成和未见语言迁移，有助于明确紧凑共享目标在什么条件下能够支撑有效干预。
zh.deck: 以紧凑的跨语言安全核心，连接机制诊断与限定 FFN 坐标的 LoRA 适配。

papers.authors: Shi Chuancheng, Li Shangze, Wu Wenhua, Hu Kun, Shen Fei, Wang Zhiyong, Chua Tat-Seng

title.en: Do correct answers have stable latent knowledge support?
title.zh: 正确答案是否具有稳定的潜在知识支撑？

summary.en: A correct answer is an observable outcome. This study asks whether its internal knowledge support stays stable when the elicitation condition changes.
summary.zh: 答对是外部结果。这项研究进一步追问：改变知识的激发条件，答案背后的内部支撑是否仍然稳定？

en.deck: A correct answer is an observable outcome. This study asks whether its internal knowledge support stays stable when the elicitation condition changes.
short: This study separates whether a model answers correctly from how consistently its internal knowledge survives controlled changes in the question. Local state stability and relational geometry offer complementary views of that consistency. EpiStableBench tests paraphrase, format, context, and language variations, making the gap between a successful answer and a stable knowledge state measurable.

The resulting picture is more informative than accuracy alone. Items that look equivalent at the output can differ in their internal stability and in their subsequent correctness. The study also explores using latent stability to guide preference optimization, connecting diagnosis to a possible intervention.
en.motivation: Output accuracy alone cannot determine whether an answer rests on stable representations. Controlled changes in how knowledge is elicited provide a way to examine the support behind the answer.
method: Average representations within each elicitation condition and correct shared shifts relative to a baseline.
Use LSS for normalized state displacement and KTS for cross-condition consistency of pairwise distances.
Evaluate controlled queries in EpiStableBench and use stability-aware preferences in LatentDPO.
en.evidence: EpiStableBench includes 4,411 items and 76,766 controlled queries. Across 16 LLMs, higher within-model stability generally accompanies better held-out accuracy, while larger or more accurate models are not consistently more stable. LatentDPO improves editing success and generalization in the evaluated integrations.
takeaway: Reliable evaluation needs to characterize the conditions under which knowledge remains accessible. A single correct response can conceal sensitivity to how the same information is elicited. Internal stability provides an additional axis for diagnosing that fragility and selecting cases for further scrutiny.

This opens a route toward evaluation that connects representation, elicitation, and behavior. The relationship must be calibrated within its setting: scores across different models are not automatically comparable, and a geometric indicator is evidence about reliability rather than a guarantee of truth.
en.thesis: A correct answer is one observation; stable knowledge is a property of the representation behind it.

zh.deck: 答对是外部结果。这项研究进一步追问：改变知识的激发条件，答案背后的内部支撑是否仍然稳定？
short: 这项工作将“回答是否正确”与“知识能否在提问变化下保持稳定”分开考察。局部知识状态和知识之间的关系几何，提供了两种互补的稳定性视角。EpiStableBench 控制改写、格式、上下文和语言等因素，使一次正确回答与稳定知识状态之间的差距能够被系统测量。
这种视角揭示了准确率难以呈现的差异：输出同样正确的知识项，内部稳定性与后续回答表现仍可能不同。工作还探索利用潜在稳定性引导偏好优化，将内部诊断进一步连接到行为改进。
zh.motivation: 仅统计答案是否正确，无法判断同一知识在不同条件下是否具有稳定的内部表示。通过受控地改变知识激发条件，可以把外部表现与内部支撑放在一起研究。
method: 分别汇总各激发条件下的内部表示，以基准条件为参照，校正不同条件之间的共享偏移。
用 LSS 衡量归一化后的知识状态位移；用 KTS 衡量知识项之间距离排序在不同条件下的一致性。
在 EpiStableBench 上开展受控评估，并通过 LatentDPO 学习考虑潜在知识稳定性的编辑策略。
zh.evidence: EpiStableBench 包含 4,411 个知识项和 76,766 个受控查询，覆盖 16 个大语言模型。模型内部更稳定的知识通常对应更好的留出条件准确率，但跨模型比较时，规模或总体准确率并不稳定地预测知识稳定性。LatentDPO 在所评估的编辑方法组合中改善了编辑成功率和泛化。
takeaway: 可靠评估需要回答知识在什么条件下仍然能够被调用。一次正确输出可能掩盖对提问方式的敏感性；内部稳定性则为识别这种脆弱性、选择值得进一步检验的知识项，增加了一条观察轴。
更长远的方向，是把表征结构、知识调用条件和最终行为放在同一条证据链中研究。不同模型的几何尺度需要分别校准，因此稳定性指标更适合作为可靠性诊断信号，其本身并不构成答案真实性的保证。
zh.thesis: 答对一次是一个观察结果；知识是否稳定，取决于支撑答案的内部表征。

papers.authors: Dou Jingtong, Shi Chuancheng, Wu Wenhua, Bao Wei, Shen Fei, Wang Zhiyong, Chua Tat-Seng

title.en: SuperAI: Merging Capabilities Across Heterogeneous Foundation Models
title.zh: SuperAI：跨异构基础模型的能力合并

summary.en: Bring complementary capabilities into one host model by aligning functional subspaces across heterogeneous foundation models.
summary.zh: 通过对齐异构基础模型的功能子空间，把多个来源的互补能力引入同一个宿主模型。

en.deck: Bring complementary capabilities into one host model by aligning functional subspaces across heterogeneous foundation models.
short: SuperAI studies how a host model can incorporate capabilities from heterogeneous source models. It identifies corresponding functional subspaces, aligns their coordinates, and learns residual mappings into the host. The useful interface is a relationship between representations, allowing sources with different architectures to contribute without requiring direct parameter correspondence.

The framework combines orthogonal subspace alignment, layer selection, and joint training of lightweight mappings. Experiments with multiple hosts and domains examine both specialist gains and retention of the host’s general capabilities as the number of sources grows.
en.motivation: Useful capabilities are distributed across models with incompatible architectures and representations. Their coordinates must be aligned before source knowledge can be meaningfully injected into a host.
method: Use shared anchor samples and PCA to construct source and host subspaces with matching dimensions.
Align source and host coordinates with orthogonal Procrustes mappings.
Train residual MLP mappings with both task outputs and source-model increments as supervision.
en.evidence: Experiments cover three host models and 15 capability domains. The framework reports higher average domain scores than the evaluated cross-architecture alternatives and better retention of general capabilities as more source models are added.
takeaway: The conceptual shift is to treat a trained model as a possible source of reusable internal computation. Architecture still matters, but functional compatibility offers another organizing principle for combining expertise. Representation alignment becomes a practical question about which information can be carried into a host and used there.

A useful composition system must also preserve the host’s existing competence and manage interference among sources. The reported evaluations make those tradeoffs visible; extending this approach to broader tasks will require testing whether alignment quality continues to predict usable capability transfer.
en.thesis: Capabilities become composable when their representations can be aligned across model boundaries.

zh.deck: 通过对齐异构基础模型的功能子空间，把多个来源的互补能力引入同一个宿主模型。
short: SuperAI 研究宿主模型如何吸收异构来源模型的能力。它寻找具有对应功能的子空间，对齐其中的坐标，再学习映射到宿主内部的残差增量。迁移接口由表征之间的关系构成，使架构不同、参数难以直接对应的模型也能够贡献专长。
框架将正交子空间对齐、层选择和轻量映射的联合训练结合起来。跨宿主、跨领域的实验，同时考察专业能力收益与宿主通用能力的保留，并分析来源模型增加时的表现。
zh.motivation: 不同模型可能分别擅长不同任务，但架构和表示坐标并不兼容。直接叠加来源模型的表示，难以保证注入的变化具有一致含义，因此需要先建立可比较的功能空间。
method: 利用共享锚点样本提取来源与宿主表示，再通过 PCA 构造维度一致的任务功能子空间。
通过正交 Procrustes 映射对齐来源与宿主坐标，在建立对应关系的同时保留子空间内部几何。
以任务输出和来源模型增量联合监督残差 MLP，学习可注入宿主的、与输入相关的增量。
zh.evidence: 实验覆盖 3 个宿主模型和 15 个能力领域。相较于所评估的跨架构融合方法，SuperAI 获得更高的平均领域得分，并在增加来源模型时更好地保留通用能力。消融结果支持正交对齐、非线性残差映射与联合监督的作用。
takeaway: 这项工作的启发在于，训练完成的模型可以被进一步视为可复用内部计算的来源。除了架构兼容性，功能兼容性也可能成为组织模型协作的原则；表征对齐则让“哪些知识能够进入另一个模型并被有效使用”成为可以研究和验证的问题。
能力组合的质量还取决于宿主原有能力的保留，以及不同来源之间的干扰。论文中的评估将这些权衡具体化，也为后续研究留下一个关键问题：对齐质量能否在更广泛任务中稳定预测实际可用的迁移收益？
zh.thesis: 当不同模型的表征能够对齐，能力才有机会跨越模型边界被组合。

papers.authors: Li Jiahua, John Zixu, Zhong Tom, Wu Fuping, Xu Tianhao, Zheng Jianqing, Mo Yuanhan, Shen Fei

title.en: Forensic Reserve: Eliciting Latent Knowledge for Image Forgery Detection
title.zh: Forensic Reserve：激发潜在知识以检测图像伪造

summary.en: Find a pretrained model’s latent forensic reserve, then constrain lightweight adaptation to those existing directions.
summary.zh: 先定位预训练模型内部的潜在鉴伪储备，再让轻量适配沿这些既有方向发挥作用。

en.deck: Find a pretrained model’s latent forensic reserve, then constrain lightweight adaptation to those existing directions.
short: Forensic Reserve studies the forensic signals already present in frozen visual encoders. F-Lens localizes sparse components that distinguish real from generated images, while Reserve-Guided Elicitation adapts constrained subspaces at the selected sites. The model’s internal structure determines where adaptation is allowed to act.

This turns interpretability into an adaptation strategy. Instead of treating every feature and layer as equally useful, the method concentrates its limited examples and trainable parameters on identified forensic reserves. Cross-backbone experiments test whether that strategy transfers beyond a single encoder.
en.motivation: A pretrained representation may already contain useful forensic signals that ordinary task adaptation does not specifically exploit. Identifying where those signals reside can guide which components should be adapted.
method: Use F-lens to decompose activations and screen components by real-versus-generated response differences.
Map selected directions back to hidden-state space and place Forensic Reserve Adapters at identified sites.
Train only coefficient maps; keep the backbone, fitted reference classifier, and subspace bases fixed.
en.evidence: With 500 labelled images and fewer than 0.2% trainable backbone parameters, RGE is evaluated on three benchmarks without target-benchmark adaptation. Improvements over corresponding frozen detectors hold across eight encoders.
takeaway: The result suggests a concrete connection between understanding a representation and using data efficiently. Locating a task-relevant subspace can reduce the degrees of freedom that must be fitted, helping adaptation exploit existing discrimination rather than reconstruct it from a small dataset.

For forensics, the central test remains robustness to unfamiliar generators and distribution changes. Reserve localization offers a mechanism for studying that robustness: which signals are reused, how adaptation changes them, and when those signals stop separating authentic and synthetic content.
en.thesis: Efficient adaptation starts by locating the task-relevant capacity a pretrained model already contains.

zh.deck: 先定位预训练模型内部的潜在鉴伪储备，再让轻量适配沿这些既有方向发挥作用。
short: Forensic Reserve 研究冻结视觉编码器中已经存在的取证信号。F-Lens 定位能够区分真实与生成图像的稀疏成分，Reserve-Guided Elicitation 则在选定位置的受限子空间中进行适配。模型内部的功能结构，由此决定适配应当作用在哪里。
这使可解释分析直接参与适配设计：有限样本与可训练参数集中于已定位的取证储备，而不同特征和层获得有区别的处理。跨骨干实验进一步检验，这种策略是否能够超越某一个特定编码器。
zh.motivation: 预训练表示可能已经包含有助于区分真实与生成图像的信号，但常规任务适配未必明确利用这些信号。先确定其位置与方向，可以为适配器的插入方式和更新空间提供依据。
method: 通过 F-lens 分解不同层与 token 组的激活，并根据真实与生成图像之间的响应差异筛选储备成分。
将选中的方向映射回隐藏状态空间，构造固定子空间，并在定位到的位置插入鉴伪储备适配器。
仅训练适配器的系数映射，固定主干、已拟合的参考分类器和子空间基，约束残差更新方向。
zh.evidence: RGE 使用 500 张标注图像，可训练参数少于主干参数的 0.2%，在不针对目标基准适配的设置下评估了 3 个检测基准。其相对对应冻结检测器的改进，在 8 个编码器上均得到观察。
takeaway: 这项研究建立了理解表征与数据效率之间的具体联系。定位任务相关子空间，能够减少小样本学习需要估计的自由度，使适配更充分地调用已有判别能力。由此，机制分析可以成为控制训练成本和适配范围的依据。
面向真实取证场景，关键仍是对未知生成器和分布变化的适应能力。取证储备提供了一个可追踪的研究对象：系统复用了哪些信号、适配怎样改变这些信号，以及这些信号在什么条件下会失去判别力。
zh.thesis: 高效适配的起点，是找到预训练模型已经拥有的任务相关能力。

title.en: EmoRSS: Mitigating Emotion-Induced Over-Refusal in Large Language Models
title.zh: EmoRSS：缓解大语言模型中情绪引发的过度拒答

summary.en: Emotional wording can make benign requests look unsafe. EmoRSS steers refusal-related activations to reduce that distortion.
summary.zh: 情绪化措辞可能使正常请求更容易遭到拒答。EmoRSS 通过干预拒答相关激活，缓解这种偏移。

en.deck: Emotional wording can make benign requests look unsafe. EmoRSS steers refusal-related activations to reduce that distortion.
short: EmoRSS investigates why emotional expression can push benign requests toward refusal. Paired queries isolate the change in expression, and sparse autoencoder features connect that change to a refusal-related subspace. The method then reverses the estimated shift during inference while keeping the underlying model frozen.

The study evaluates benign assistance and harmful-request refusal together. This matters because a lower refusal rate is useful only when it reflects better calibration of legitimate requests, while preserving the model’s ability to reject harmful ones.
en.motivation: Safety decisions should depend on the requested action as well as its context. Benign queries can be unnecessarily refused when emotional expression increases refusal tendencies.
method: Locate a refusal-sensitive layer with linear probes and construct an SAE-based refusal subspace.
Compare paired regular and emotional versions of the same queries to estimate a mean feature shift.
Decode that shift into a hidden-state vector and intervene in the reverse refusal direction without backbone updates.
en.evidence: Experiments on two LLMs jointly examine harmful-request refusal, benign-request answering, and general performance. The reported trade-off is more favourable than the compared over-refusal mitigation baselines under emotional wording.
takeaway: Helpful safety requires sensitivity to what a user is asking for and stability to how that need is expressed. Emotional distress can be part of a legitimate request; treating that expression as a substitute for risk can systematically withhold assistance from the people who need it.

By connecting a behavioral disparity to an intervenable internal direction, this work offers a mechanism for studying that calibration. Its scope is defined by the tested models and paired-query settings, motivating broader evaluation across emotions, tasks, and conversational contexts.
en.thesis: Safety calibration depends on distinguishing harmful intent from the emotional form of a legitimate request.

zh.deck: 情绪化措辞可能使正常请求更容易遭到拒答。EmoRSS 通过干预拒答相关激活，缓解这种偏移。
short: EmoRSS 研究情绪表达为何会把良性请求推向拒答。配对问题用于隔离表达方式的变化，稀疏自编码器特征则把这种变化与拒答相关子空间联系起来。方法在保持基础模型冻结的情况下，于推理时逆转估计出的偏移。
评估同时关注良性问题的有效回答与有害问题的拒答能力。这一联合视角很关键：拒答减少是否有意义，取决于系统能否更准确地识别正当请求，并继续维持对有害意图的防护。
zh.motivation: 情绪表达不仅可能出现在攻击中，也可能出现在正常求助与日常问题中。如果情绪因素本身提高了拒答倾向，模型就可能拒绝本来可以回答的请求。
method: 用逐层线性探针定位拒答敏感层，再从与探针方向对齐的 SAE 特征中构建拒答子空间。
比较同一问题的普通版本与情绪化版本，估计拒答子空间中相关特征的平均激活偏移。
将偏移解码为隐藏状态干预向量，在推理时沿反向拒答方向施加干预，无需更新主干参数。
zh.evidence: 在两个大语言模型上，实验同时考察有害请求拒答、正常请求回答与通用任务表现。在包含情绪表达的设置下，EmoRSS 相比所比较的过度拒答缓解方法，实现了更有利的综合权衡。
takeaway: 有帮助的安全系统，需要对用户所请求的行为敏感，也需要对表达方式保持适当稳定。情绪和困境可以是正当需求的一部分；如果它们被模型当作风险的替代信号，真正需要帮助的用户就可能被系统性地挡在服务之外。
这项工作把行为上的校准偏差连接到可干预的内部方向，为研究安全与帮助性如何共同实现提供了机制线索。现有结论来自所测试的模型与配对问题设置，后续仍需拓展到更丰富的情绪、任务和多轮对话。

title.en: ContractLens: Latent Security Knowledge for Malicious Smart Contract Detection
title.zh: ContractLens：利用潜在安全知识检测恶意智能合约

summary.en: Localize latent security signals and use a compact set of internal units to detect malicious smart contracts.
summary.zh: 定位模型中的潜在安全信号，利用紧凑的内部神经单元表示检测恶意智能合约。

en.deck: Localize latent security signals and use a compact set of internal units to detect malicious smart contracts.
short: ContractLens uses this pair of requirements to locate malicious-contract detection units inside a frozen language model. It compares the effects of removing malicious logic with behavior-preserving edits such as formatting and comment changes. Critical layers and neurons are selected for their ability to separate malicious behavior, respond to its removal, and resist irrelevant variation.

The selected units feed a lightweight detector. The framework makes feature selection a question about security semantics, connecting internal measurements to an application where shortcuts based on appearance can be particularly costly.
en.motivation: Prompt-based auditing exposes model responses but does not directly characterize the representations supporting malicious-logic detection. ContractLens asks which internal signals track the logic rather than incidental surface form.
method: Probe candidate layers and test sensitivity to malicious-logic removal and stability under behaviour-preserving changes.
Combine activation contrast, malicious-logic specificity, and probe weights to rank units and select a knee point.
Concatenate selected activations into a compact representation for a lightweight detector.
en.evidence: Masking MCDUs produces larger detection drops than random or activation-matched controls. Evaluation across three pretrained models reports higher average accuracy than the compared methods, including tests of unseen malicious intents and few-label classifiers.
takeaway: The insight extends to how security evidence should be built: predictive accuracy becomes more persuasive when a feature changes for the reason the task requires. Controlled logic edits and surface edits turn that expectation into measurable criteria.

This offers a route to detectors whose representations can be audited for task relevance, including in low-label and unseen-intent settings. Real deployment still requires examining the coverage of malicious behaviors and the fidelity of the edits used to test semantic sensitivity.
en.thesis: A security representation should react to a change in malicious logic and remain stable to a change in surface form.

zh.deck: 定位模型中的潜在安全信号，利用紧凑的内部神经单元表示检测恶意智能合约。
short: ContractLens 依据这两个要求，在冻结语言模型中定位恶意合约检测单元。它比较移除恶意逻辑与保留行为的格式、注释等修改所产生的影响，选择既能区分恶意行为、感知其移除，又能抵抗无关变化的关键层与神经元。
选出的单元被用于轻量检测器。特征选择由此围绕安全语义展开，使内部测量能够服务于一个对表面捷径尤其敏感的真实任务。
zh.motivation: 提示式审计能够获得模型判断，却难以直接说明判断所依赖的内部表示。ContractLens 关注哪些信号与恶意逻辑有关，以及它们能否在代码表面形式变化后保持稳定。
method: 先用逐层线性探针识别候选层，再检验移除恶意逻辑时的敏感性，以及行为保持的表面修改下的稳定性。
融合激活对比、恶意逻辑特异性和探针权重，形成三因素重要性得分，并利用排序曲线的拐点选取单元。
拼接所选单元的激活，构造紧凑表示，用于训练轻量检测器。
zh.evidence: 屏蔽 MCDU 导致的检测性能下降，大于随机单元及激活幅度匹配单元的对照。三个预训练模型上的评估报告了相对所比较方法更高的平均准确率，并进一步检验了未见恶意意图与少标注分类器设置。
takeaway: 这项工作的洞见也体现在安全证据应当如何建立：当一个特征会因为任务真正关心的因素而变化时，它的预测能力才更有解释力。恶意逻辑修改与表面修改构成的对照，让这种要求成为可以量化检验的标准。
这一思路为审查检测器是否使用任务相关表征提供了路径，也适用于标签有限和恶意意图变化的情形。面向部署，还需要持续检验恶意行为覆盖范围，以及用于验证语义敏感性的代码修改是否忠实保留了预期语义。
zh.thesis: 安全表征应当对恶意逻辑的变化敏感，同时对无关表面变化保持稳定。

title.en: DV-Lens: Revealing the Functional Organization of Language Model Parameters
title.zh: DV-Lens：揭示语言模型参数的功能组织

summary.en: A vocabulary-space view of native parameters, tested through local output changes and targeted interventions.
summary.zh: 把原生参数映射到词表空间，再用局部输出变化和定向干预检验这些读出。

en.deck: A vocabulary-space view of native parameters, tested through local output changes and targeted interventions.
short: DV-Lens treats the vocabulary as a shared coordinate system for interpreting native parameters. By following the downstream computation, it translates parameter directions into signed local output responses: which tokens a direction tends to promote, and which it tends to suppress. This connects the internal organization of attention and feed-forward modules to a common, testable interface.

The study then asks whether that functional organization contains information about model capability. DV-Complexity summarizes variation within functionally grouped parameters. Finite-difference checks, targeted interventions, and a comparison across 48 models connect the proposed readouts to observable behavior at different scales.
en.motivation: A parameter interpretation becomes more useful when it predicts what will change in the output. The challenge is to connect parameters from different modules to a common, verifiable output space.
method: Estimate downstream Jacobians for attention Q/K/V/O projections and FFNs over reference prompts.
Project native parameter columns into vocabulary space to obtain signed local readouts.
Group columns by their readouts and measure within-group structural variation with DV-Complexity.
en.evidence: Finite-difference tests report 98.0% coordinate-orientation agreement across 720 cases from nine models. Readouts also guide ablation, steering, and swapping across 21 models. Across 48 models, joint-parameter DV-Complexity correlates with capability rankings at Spearman ρ = 0.904.
takeaway: The broader opportunity is to make interpretability predictive. A parameter map can support specific hypotheses about editing, steering, or transferring behavior when its readouts survive intervention tests. That makes the explanation part of an experimental workflow, rather than an endpoint.

DV-Complexity also suggests that capability may depend on how parameters are organized, alongside how many parameters a model contains. Its correlation with benchmark rankings motivates controlled studies of that relationship; the reported association alone does not establish that increasing this measure will improve a model.
en.thesis: An explanation of a parameter becomes useful when it predicts a change in the model’s output.

zh.deck: 把原生参数映射到词表空间，再用局部输出变化和定向干预检验这些读出。
short: DV-Lens 把词表作为理解原生参数的共同坐标系。它沿着模型的下游计算，将参数方向转化为带符号的局部输出响应：一个方向倾向于增强哪些词、抑制哪些词。由此，注意力与前馈模块中原本难以直接比较的参数，获得了可在输出端检验的功能描述。
工作进一步追问：参数的功能组织方式，是否包含关于模型能力的信息？DV-Complexity 刻画功能分组内部的结构变化，并通过有限差分、定向干预和 48 个模型的比较，将参数读出与不同尺度上的可观察行为联系起来。
zh.motivation: 理解参数的含义，需要进一步回答：改变这个参数，输出会怎样变化？不同模块的参数处于不同空间，直接比较它们的功能并不容易。因此，这项工作把最终词表作为共同的观察空间。
method: 在参考提示上估计注意力 Q/K/V/O 投影及 FFN 的下游 Jacobian，建立模块到最终输出的局部映射。
把原生参数列投影到词表空间，得到描述平均局部输出响应的带符号读出。
按词表读出对参数列分组，再利用原始权重的归一化重建残差，刻画组内结构变化。
zh.evidence: 有限差分检验覆盖 9 个模型、720 个案例，局部变化方向的一致率为 98.0%。读出还用于 21 个模型上的消融、引导和参数替换。在 48 个模型上，联合参数 DV-Complexity 与基准能力排序的 Spearman 相关系数达到 0.904。
takeaway: 这项研究指向一种具有预测力的可解释性：解释需要提出关于行为变化的具体假设，并通过干预接受检验。满足这一条件的参数地图，可以成为模型编辑、行为引导与能力迁移的实验接口，让“理解模型”进一步连接到“如何操作模型”。
DV-Complexity 也提示，除了参数规模，参数如何被组织可能同样值得研究。它与能力排序的相关性，为后续受控实验提供了线索；是否能通过主动改变这种组织来提升能力，仍需要独立的因果证据。

title.en: BARQ: Balanced Codebook Refinement for Low-Bit LLM Quantization
title.zh: BARQ：面向低比特大语言模型量化的平衡码本优化

summary.en: Improve low-bit quantization by giving codewords balanced opportunities to learn during fitting.
summary.zh: 在拟合阶段为各个码字提供更均衡的更新机会，以改善低比特量化质量。

en.deck: Improve low-bit quantization by giving codewords balanced opportunities to learn during fitting.
short: BARQ studies codeword concentration during vector quantization. When many weight blocks collapse onto a small subset of codewords, nominal capacity can be poorly used. The method introduces balanced soft assignments through optimal transport, combines them with a curvature-aware cost, and refines codewords using barycentric updates.

The balance constraint guides codebook fitting; deployment uses ordinary hard assignments and codeword lookup. This separates the geometry of finding a useful compressed representation from the format used to store and execute it.
en.motivation: Nearest-codeword fitting can give some codewords too little updating mass. An underused codebook wastes representational capacity precisely when low-bit deployment makes that capacity scarce.
method: Solve entropically regularized optimal transport with uniform marginals and curvature-weighted reconstruction costs.
Update codewords using assignment-weighted barycentres, with fixed-assignment optimality conditions.
Discard fitting-time soft assignments and encode weights with standard hard nearest-codeword assignments.
en.evidence: The paper establishes sufficient conditions for improved hard-quantization distortion and evaluation loss. Across the evaluated LLMs and comparable bit budgets, it reports lower perplexity and higher mean zero-shot accuracy than the compared baselines.
takeaway: Compression can therefore be understood as an allocation problem: a limited set of discrete representatives must cover weight structure according to its effect on the model. Assignment geometry becomes an additional design variable alongside precision and block size.

The practical question is whether better use of a fixed codebook translates into retained capability. BARQ evaluates that link with codeword-use diagnostics and paired model-quality comparisons, making the mechanism and its downstream value visible in the same study.
en.thesis: Low-bit compression depends on how a model uses its discrete codebook, as well as how many bits it stores.

zh.deck: 在拟合阶段为各个码字提供更均衡的更新机会，以改善低比特量化质量。
short: BARQ 研究向量量化中的码字集中现象：大量权重块聚集到少数码字，会使名义上的表示容量难以有效利用。方法通过最优传输构造平衡软分配，结合曲率感知的代价，并以重心更新细化码字。
平衡约束作用于码本拟合阶段，部署仍采用常规硬分配与码字查找。这一区分使寻找压缩表示时的优化几何，与最终存储和执行时的格式各司其职。
zh.motivation: 最近码字分配可能使部分码字获得的更新权重过少，导致有效码本利用不足。对于表示容量已经受限的低比特部署，这会进一步影响重建质量。
method: 采用带熵正则的最优传输，在均匀边缘约束和曲率加权重建代价下建立软分配。
根据分配权重进行码字重心更新，并分析固定分配条件下的最优性及有限 Sinkhorn 迭代的适用条件。
拟合结束后丢弃软分配，使用优化后的码本进行标准硬最近码字编码。
zh.evidence: 论文给出了改善硬量化失真和评估损失的充分条件。在所评估的大语言模型和可比比特预算下，实验报告了相对所比较基线更低的困惑度，以及更高的平均零样本准确率。
takeaway: 从这一视角看，压缩也是一种容量分配问题：有限的离散代表需要按照权重对模型行为的影响，去覆盖复杂的权重结构。除了位宽和分块大小，分配方式本身也成为可设计的变量。
最终价值取决于码本利用的改善能否转化为能力保留。BARQ 将码字使用诊断与成对的模型质量比较结合起来，使压缩机制及其行为收益能够在同一条证据链上被观察。
zh.thesis: 低比特压缩的效果，也取决于有限码本是否被充分而合理地使用。

title.en: ACTR: Aligning Thoughts and Responses for Multilingual Safety in Reasoning LLMs
title.zh: ACTR：对齐思考与回答，提升推理模型的多语言安全性

summary.en: A reasoning model may recognize a safety risk in its thoughts yet still produce an unsafe answer in another language.
summary.zh: 推理模型可能已经在思考中识别风险，却仍在另一种语言的回答中给出不安全内容。

en.deck: A reasoning model may recognize a safety risk in its thoughts yet still produce an unsafe answer in another language.
short: ACTR studies a gap in multilingual safety: a model can identify danger in its reasoning yet produce an unsafe final response, especially in non-high-resource languages. Think Gap Score measures differences in reasoning utilization, while safety-think neurons identify internal components associated with carrying safety reasoning into behavior.

The framework selectively optimizes these neurons and introduces a consistency signal between reasoning and response. It targets the connection between recognizing a risk and acting on it, with evaluation across languages and attack settings.
en.motivation: Recognizing risk does not guarantee that the response uses that recognition. This gap is especially important under jailbreak attacks in non-high-resource languages.
method: Measure reasoning-trace contributions with TGS and examine safety changes under trace substitution.
Compare neuron importance with reasoning enabled and disabled to identify safety think neurons.
Use a frozen judge to reward safety-category consistency while updating only selected neuron-associated parameters.
en.evidence: Across two reasoning models, ACTR is evaluated on AdvBench-X and MultiJail. It reports lower average attack success rates than the compared methods, with gains extending to unseen languages while limiting benign false refusals.
takeaway: This makes safety a question about the continuity of computation. A model needs to detect a harmful request, retain that judgment through generation, and let it shape the answer. A failure at any transition can leave apparently sound reasoning disconnected from the response users receive.

The multilingual setting makes this gap especially visible. Improving the use of safety reasoning offers a more specific intervention target than treating every unsafe response as an absence of safety knowledge; its value must be assessed jointly with useful responses and transfer to languages outside training.
en.thesis: Recognizing a risk in reasoning is only useful when that recognition constrains the final action.

zh.deck: 推理模型可能已经在思考中识别风险，却仍在另一种语言的回答中给出不安全内容。
short: ACTR 研究多语言安全中的一种脱节：模型在推理里已经意识到危险，最终却仍然给出不安全回答，这一现象在非高资源语言中尤其值得关注。Think Gap Score 衡量推理利用的差异，安全思考神经元则定位与将安全推理落实到行为相关的内部成分。
框架选择性地优化这些神经元，并引入思考与回答之间的一致性信号。干预目标因此落在风险识别与最终行动的连接上，再通过不同语言和攻击设置检验其效果。
zh.motivation: “推理中识别出风险”与“回答中执行安全判断”之间可能存在断层。这种断层在非高资源语言的越狱攻击下尤其值得关注。
method: 用 TGS 比较推理轨迹对回答生成的贡献，并通过轨迹替换考察跨语言安全差距。
比较开启与关闭推理时的神经元重要性，定位支持安全推理利用的神经元。
借助冻结裁判模型奖励思考与回答的安全类别一致性，仅更新所选神经元关联参数，不依赖人工标注回答或偏好数据。
zh.evidence: ACTR 在两个推理模型上使用 AdvBench-X 和 MultiJail 进行评估。相较于所比较方法，其平均攻击成功率更低，收益还延伸到未见语言；实验同时考察了正常请求误拒答及多语言知识和数学推理表现。
takeaway: 这项工作把安全性放到计算过程的连续性中理解。模型需要识别有害请求、在生成过程中保留判断，并让该判断实际影响答案。任何一个环节的脱节，都可能让看似合理的推理与用户收到的回答分离。
多语言情形使这种缺口更加清晰。改善安全推理的利用，为干预提供了更具体的目标，也帮助区分安全知识缺失与知识未能落实到行为。方法的价值仍需结合有用性，以及对训练之外语言的迁移表现共同判断。
zh.thesis: 推理中识别出风险，只有进一步约束最终行为，才能形成有效的安全能力。

title.en: Hub-Spectral Activation of Latent Multimodal Knowledge
title.zh: Hub-Spectral：激活潜在多模态知识

summary.en: A shared hub can hide useful cross-modal relations that native similarity scores do not reliably expose.
summary.zh: 共享枢纽中可能包含原生相似度分数未能可靠揭示的跨模态关系。

en.deck: A shared hub can hide useful cross-modal relations that native similarity scores do not reliably expose.
short: Hub-Spectral Activation studies latent relationships between modalities that share a hub. It builds a second-order view of the two hub-linked edges, identifies paired spectral directions, and uses them to read out a relation between the target modalities. The construction uses frozen representations without direct target-pair supervision.

The study tests this readout on retrieval and prototype classification. Permutation controls and source-sample analyses examine whether the improvements depend on meaningful correspondence in the hub edges, connecting performance gains to a concrete structural account.
en.motivation: Training two modalities against a shared hub does not guarantee their mutual alignment. The question is which part of their relation is identifiable from the two trained hub edges.
method: Compose and standardize the second-order statistics of the two source-trained hub edges.
Extract paired spectral directions to represent the hub-readable component.
Combine reliability-weighted matching and source-gated candidate resolution for retrieval and prototype classification.
en.evidence: Across ImageBind and LanguageBind, mean bidirectional Recall@10 rises from 18.27% to 31.15% over 19 relations. Mean macro Top-1 rises from 29.01% to 52.43% over 11 prototype-classification relations.
takeaway: The central implication is a distinction between the information a model contains and the interface used to access it. Weak performance under frozen cosine similarity can reflect a limited readout of the available relational structure. Studying that interface can reveal capability that additional backbone training is not required to create in the tested setting.

Recoverability still depends on the hub and the statistical structure available in its two edges. The paper’s controls help define those conditions, suggesting a research program around when shared coordinates support useful cross-modal composition and when they do not.
en.thesis: What a representation can express may exceed what its default similarity interface can reveal.

zh.deck: 共享枢纽中可能包含原生相似度分数未能可靠揭示的跨模态关系。
short: Hub-Spectral Activation 研究通过共享枢纽连接的模态之间，是否存在尚未被有效读出的关系。它从两条枢纽边构造二阶统计视角，定位成对的谱方向，再据此读出目标模态之间的关系；这一过程使用冻结表征，不依赖目标模态对的直接监督。
工作在检索和原型分类上检验读出效果，并通过对应关系置乱与来源样本分析，研究收益是否依赖枢纽边中有意义的结构，将性能改善连接到具体的机制解释。
zh.motivation: 两种模态分别与同一枢纽对齐，并不自动保证它们之间也能可靠对齐。这项工作研究：仅凭两条已训练的枢纽连接，能确定并恢复多少跨模态关系？
method: 组合并标准化两条来源枢纽连接的二阶统计量，刻画来源诱导的跨模态依赖。
提取成对谱方向，表示可由枢纽读出的关系成分，并分析其可恢复条件及维度边界。
结合可靠性加权匹配与来源门控候选解析，用于双向检索和原型分类，无需目标模态对监督或主干更新。
zh.evidence: 在 ImageBind 和 LanguageBind 上，19 个检索关系的平均双向 Recall@10 从 18.27% 提升到 31.15%；11 个原型分类关系的平均宏 Top-1 从 29.01% 提升到 52.43%。
takeaway: 其核心启发，是区分模型包含的信息与访问这些信息的接口。冻结余弦相似度下的弱表现，可能反映的是关系读出受限。重新研究这一接口，有机会在所测试的设置中激活已有结构，而无需通过更新骨干来重新建立它。
可恢复的关系仍受枢纽选择及两条边的统计结构约束。论文中的对照实验帮助刻画这些条件，也引出更系统的问题：共享坐标在何时足以支持跨模态能力组合，又在何时会失效？

title.en: MAE I Trust Myself? Self-Evaluating VLA Action Generation with Markov Attention Entropy
title.zh: MAE I Trust Myself? 用马尔可夫注意力熵自评估 VLA 动作可靠性

summary.en: Architecture-aware attention entropy turns a VLA’s internal visual addressing into an action-reliability signal.
summary.zh: 利用架构感知的注意力熵，将 VLA 内部视觉寻址转化为动作可靠性信号。

papers.authors: Aniri, Chen Yilin, Bi Jinhe, Jin Zengjie, Wang Yujun, Tian Yijun, Tresp Volker, Shen Fei, Chua Tat-Seng, Ma Yunpu

figures.caption: Figure 3 Unified Conditional Generative Markov Chain view of heterogeneous VLAs. Visual observations, language instructions, and State Input form the conditioning context, while latent action states evolve through architecture- specific transition kernels before the executable action is produced. MAE reads attention entropy from this internal transition process and converts it into architecture-aware self-evaluation scores.

title.zh: 共同视角与架构感知读出

explanation.en: The framework extracts internal visual addressing and applies the appropriate MAE orientation.

title.zh: 异构策略中的可靠性评估

explanation.en: The source table compares evaluation metrics across three policies and the benchmark’s task subsets.
explanation.zh: 原表比较三类策略在不同任务子集上的评估指标。

en.thesis: A reliability signal must be interpreted in relation to the computation that produces the action.
short: MAE studies whether vision–language–action models can assess their own action generation using internal attention signals. A conditional generative Markov-chain view supplies a common abstraction across latent readout and latent refinement, while the score remains aware of their different computational roles.

That distinction matters: visual concentration associated with reliable readout does not imply that the same entropy orientation is appropriate for iterative refinement. MAE-D and MAE-C use architecture-aware orientations, turning visual addressing into comparable reliability rankings without expert failure labels for score training.
en.motivation: Output uncertainty provides only a partial view of robotic action generation, especially when policies use different action heads or refinement procedures. Internal signals may contain additional evidence, but a uniform interpretation can erase the architectural differences that give those signals meaning.
method: Represent heterogeneous action-generation procedures through a shared conditional latent-transition abstraction.
Extract visual-attention entropy and use the appropriate orientation for latent-readout or latent-refinement policies.
Evaluate reliability rankings on LIBERO-Reflect with standard and challenging episodes across several task subsets.
en.evidence: LIBERO-Reflect contains 4,000 episodes, split evenly between standard and challenging conditions. Evaluations cover OpenVLA, OpenVLA-OFT, and QwenPI-Flow and report AUPR, AUROC, and FPR@95. Ablations compare visual and text heads, selection scope, efficiency, and repeated simulator seeds.
takeaway: The work connects self-evaluation to the structure of the computation being evaluated. Attention entropy becomes useful when its direction and location are matched to the action-generation mechanism; the same numerical tendency can mean different things in different architectures.

This offers a route toward monitoring based on existing internal information. A reliability ranking can inform future decisions about intervention or fallback, while threshold calibration and closed-loop benefits require their own evaluation beyond a successful ranking experiment.
en.deck: Architecture-aware attention entropy turns a VLA’s internal visual addressing into an action-reliability signal.

zh.thesis: 可靠性信号的含义，需要结合动作究竟通过什么计算过程生成来理解。
short: MAE 研究 VLA 能否通过内部注意力信号评估自身动作生成。条件生成马尔可夫链提供了贯通潜在读出与潜在细化的共同抽象，而评分仍然保留二者在计算作用上的区别。
这种区别尤其关键：与可靠读出相伴的视觉注意力集中，并不意味着迭代细化也应采用相同的熵方向。MAE-D 与 MAE-C 根据架构选择评分方向，将视觉寻址转化为可靠性排序信号，无需用专家失败标签训练该评分。
zh.motivation: 输出不确定性只能观察机器人动作生成的部分信息，不同动作头与细化过程又进一步增加了比较难度。内部信号可能提供补充证据，但统一套用相同解释，也可能抹去决定信号含义的架构差异。
method: 通过共同的条件潜在状态转移抽象，描述异构动作生成过程。
提取视觉注意力熵，并为潜在读出与潜在细化选择相应评分方向。
在 LIBERO-Reflect 的标准与挑战场景中，比较多个任务子集上的可靠性排序。
zh.evidence: LIBERO-Reflect 包含 4,000 个回合，标准与挑战条件各占一半。评估覆盖 OpenVLA、OpenVLA-OFT 与 QwenPI-Flow，报告 AUPR、AUROC、FPR@95，并分析视觉与文本头、选择范围、效率及不同模拟种子的稳定性。
takeaway: 这项工作将自评估与被评估计算的结构联系起来。注意力熵的价值，取决于其方向与位置是否对应实际动作生成机制；相同的数值趋势，在不同架构中可能具有不同含义。
这为利用已有内部信息开展运行监测提供了路径。可靠性排序能够为后续干预或回退策略提供依据，而阈值校准与闭环任务收益，还需要在排序实验之外单独验证。

highlights.label: 评估覆盖的 VLA 策略

zh.deck: 利用架构感知的注意力熵，将 VLA 内部视觉寻址转化为动作可靠性信号。

title.en: Who Bridges Safety? Identifying and Targeting Cross-Lingual Shared Safety Pathways
title.zh: 谁在桥接安全？定位并增强跨语言共享安全路径

summary.en: Tracing cross-layer safety pathways reveals a shared target for transferring refusal behavior across languages.
summary.zh: 追踪跨层安全信号的传播路径，定位跨语言安全迁移的共享干预目标。

papers.authors: Miao Shuyi, Qiu Wangjie, Shao Pengyang, Xiao Canran, Shen Fei, Zheng Zhiming, Chua Tat-Seng

(1) Pathways Identification: Construction of safety pathways via co-activation and activation-propagation. (2) Shared Pathways: Extraction of the intersection between HR and NHR pathways to form a cross-lingual safety core. (3) Pathways-Targeted Cross-Lingual Alignment: Exclusive fine-tuning of the safety pathways to improve cross-lingual refusal consistency.

title.zh: 追踪跨层安全信号

explanation.en: The framework combines pathway identification, cross-language intersection, and pathway-targeted alignment.
explanation.zh: 框架结合路径识别、跨语言交集提取与路径定向对齐。

figures.caption: Table 2: Validation of shared pathways. Masking the shared pathways P⋆ λ induces a significantly larger ASR increase than a size-matched random baseline, confirming it encodes essential cross-lingual safety pathways.

title.zh: 检验共享路径的作用

explanation.en: Shared-path masking is compared with a size-matched random control on multilingual attacks.
explanation.zh: 在多语言攻击中，将共享路径屏蔽与同规模随机对照比较。

figures.caption: Table 3: Comparison of attack success rate (ASR,%, ↓) on AdvBench-x and MultiJail. We achieve the lowest average ASR across both base models, outperforming representative preference optimization and cross-lingual alignment baselines.

title.zh: 对齐后的多语言安全表现

explanation.en: The original table compares attack success rates across languages and alignment methods.
explanation.zh: 原表比较不同语言和对齐方法下的攻击成功率。

en.thesis: A shared safety component matters through the computation it helps carry across layers and languages.
short: Who Bridges Safety studies multilingual safety as a problem of signal propagation. It identifies cross-layer pathways using both co-activation and activation-propagation measurements, then examines the paths shared by high-resource and non-high-resource languages. The unit of analysis is a connection between components, extending the view provided by isolated-neuron measurements.

The resulting shared pathways guide selective alignment. Masking experiments test their functional relevance, while targeted updates examine whether strengthening the shared computation improves refusal behavior in less well-protected languages without broadly changing the model.
en.motivation: Models can understand a language while failing to apply a safety judgment in it. Locating individual safety-related neurons helps identify relevant components, but leaves open how their signals combine and propagate into a refusal decision.
method: Identify language-specific safety pathways from cross-layer co-activation and activation propagation.
Intersect the pathway sets across languages and compare targeted masking with size-matched random controls.
Concentrate alignment updates on shared pathway parameters and evaluate multilingual safety together with general capabilities.
en.evidence: The selected masking controls show larger safety degradation when shared pathways are disrupted than when matched random pathways are disrupted. Multilingual evaluations compare targeted alignment with preference-optimization and cross-language baselines; additional experiments examine training efficiency, general capability retention, and leave-one-language-out transfer.
takeaway: The work makes the connectivity of a safety mechanism an explicit research target. A model may contain relevant components yet fail to coordinate them effectively in a particular language. Path-level analysis connects those two possibilities to interventions that can be tested.

This suggests a mechanism-aware approach to transfer: identify a shared computation, validate its role, and then optimize where that computation is carried. The evidence supports the studied pathway constructions and languages; how broadly those bridges generalize remains a question for further controlled evaluation.
en.deck: Tracing cross-layer safety pathways reveals a shared target for transferring refusal behavior across languages.

zh.thesis: 共享安全成分的作用，体现在它如何跨越层与语言参与完整的决策计算。
short: Who Bridges Safety 将多语言安全视为信号传播问题。工作结合共激活与激活传播，识别跨层安全路径，再研究高资源与非高资源语言共享哪些路径。分析单元由孤立神经元延伸到成分之间的连接，使安全信号如何形成最终拒答成为可追踪的问题。
这些共享路径进一步用于指导选择性对齐。屏蔽实验检验其功能相关性，定向更新则考察增强共享计算能否改善防护较弱语言的安全表现，同时控制对一般能力的影响。
zh.motivation: 模型能够理解一种语言，并不意味着它会在这种语言中有效使用安全判断。定位安全相关神经元揭示了重要成分，进一步还需要回答：这些成分如何协同，以及安全信号如何跨层传递到最终决策。
method: 结合跨层共激活和激活传播，构建各语言的安全路径集合。
提取不同语言之间的共享路径，并通过与同规模随机路径对照的屏蔽实验检验其作用。
将对齐更新集中到共享路径参数，联合评估多语言安全与一般能力保留。
zh.evidence: 对照实验中，屏蔽共享路径比屏蔽同规模随机路径造成更明显的安全退化。论文进一步将路径定向对齐与偏好优化、跨语言对齐基线比较，并考察训练效率、一般能力保留和留一语言迁移。
takeaway: 这项工作把安全机制的连接方式确立为具体的研究对象。模型可能已经拥有相关成分，却没有在某种语言中有效组织这些成分；路径分析使这两种情况能够通过有针对性的实验加以区分。
由此可以形成一条机制驱动的迁移路线：识别共享计算、验证其作用，再优化承载这些计算的位置。现有证据来自所研究的路径构造与语言设置，更广泛的迁移边界仍值得通过受控实验刻画。
zh.deck: 追踪跨层安全信号的传播路径，定位跨语言安全迁移的共享干预目标。

title.en: OPD-V: Visual On-Policy Self-Distillation with Modality Balance
title.zh: OPD-V：以模态平衡引导视觉同策略自蒸馏

summary.en: Visual teacher contrasts select self-distillation tokens that receive stronger support from the image.
summary.zh: 通过视觉教师对照，选择获得更强图像证据支持的自蒸馏词元。

(A) For the same student-generated response, the Positive Teacher, student, and Negative Teacher score each on-policy token under the Zoom-In Image, Original Image, and Mask Image, respectively. (B) The tokenwise Modality-Balance Logits Margin compares the log probabilities assigned by the Positive Teacher and Negative Teacher; tokens with positive margins form the Modality-Balance Trust Region. (C) OPD-V applies Jensen–Shannon distillation from the Positive Teacher distribution to the student only within this region.

title.zh: 选择获得视觉支持的更新

explanation.en: Positive and negative teacher conditions define a token-level trust region for on-policy distillation.
explanation.zh: 正负教师条件共同定义同策略蒸馏的词元级信任区域。

These matched conditions expose distinct degrees of Modality Imbalance. For each margin interval b, the blue curve reports ∆ρb = |b|−1 P

title.zh: 将模态平衡作为诊断信号

explanation.en: The analysis links visual-attention balance, teacher behavior, and the proposed privileged signal.
explanation.zh: 分析连接视觉注意力平衡、教师行为与所提出的额外监督信息。

figures.caption: Figure 4: Absolute accuracy of OPD-V across diverse model architectures (Qwen3-VL-Instruct 4B/8B and Qwen3.5 9B). Connected points compare the Base model, OPSD, and OPD-V on each benchmark. Model panels use independently zoomed y-axes to make within-backbone differences visible without altering the reported scores. The Average cards are independently scaled and annotate exact values for the Base model, GPT-5.2, Kimi-K2.6, and OPD-V.

title.zh: 跨骨干比较

explanation.en: The source plots compare benchmark accuracy across model architectures and post-training methods.
explanation.zh: 原图比较不同模型架构与后训练方法的基准准确率。

en.thesis: A useful distillation signal should reward how a teacher uses visual evidence, alongside what it predicts.
short: OPD-V examines modality imbalance in visual on-policy self-distillation. A teacher can be confident while relying mainly on textual context, leaving the additional visual information underused. The method contrasts a zoom-in positive teacher with an image-masked negative teacher under matched text and student-generated prefixes.

Their token-logit margin defines a modality-balance trust region. Distillation focuses on tokens for which the positive visual condition supplies stronger support, connecting the selection of supervision to evidence use rather than treating every confident teacher output equally.
en.motivation: Privileged information improves training only when the teacher effectively uses it. In a multimodal model, confidence and correctness alone may not reveal whether an apparent reasoning signal depends on the image.
method: Score the same student-generated tokens with the original-image student, zoom-in positive teacher, and masked-image negative teacher.
Use positive modality-balance logit margins to select an on-policy trust region.
Apply Jensen–Shannon self-distillation from the positive teacher on the selected tokens and compare quality and training cost.
en.evidence: Experiments span six benchmarks, four multimodal backbones, and five post-training methods. Analyses compare attention balance and teacher behavior, training dynamics, component ablations, and wall-clock step time. The reported results support the proposed supervision-selection criterion in those settings.
takeaway: The work treats the quality of supervision as partly a question of information dependence. Contrasting visual conditions helps identify where a teacher’s support is associated with richer visual input, providing a practical way to use that distinction during training.

This connects evaluation and optimization: a diagnostic of modality use becomes a criterion for selecting which updates to trust. The larger question is when that criterion continues to track genuinely useful evidence across image transformations, tasks, and model families.
en.deck: Visual teacher contrasts select self-distillation tokens that receive stronger support from the image.

zh.thesis: 有价值的蒸馏监督，也应考虑教师如何使用视觉证据。
short: OPD-V 研究视觉同策略自蒸馏中的模态失衡。教师即使置信度较高，也可能主要依赖文本上下文，使额外视觉信息未被充分使用。方法在相同文本与学生生成前缀下，对比放大图像的正教师和遮蔽图像的负教师。
两类教师的词元 logit 差构成模态平衡信任区域，将蒸馏集中到正向视觉条件提供更强支持的词元，使监督选择与证据利用联系起来。
zh.motivation: 额外信息能否改善训练，取决于教师是否实际使用这些信息。对于多模态模型，置信度和正确性本身，未必足以说明某个推理信号是否依赖图像。
method: 让原图学生、放大图像正教师与遮蔽图像负教师，对同一学生生成词元进行评分。
根据正的模态平衡 logit 差，选择同策略信任区域。
在选定词元上进行正教师引导的 Jensen–Shannon 蒸馏，并比较效果与训练开销。
zh.evidence: 实验覆盖六个基准、四类多模态骨干与五种后训练方法，同时分析注意力平衡、教师行为、训练动态、模块消融和每步墙钟时间，检验监督选择标准在这些设置下的作用。
takeaway: 这项工作将监督质量与信息依赖联系起来。通过对照不同视觉条件，可以识别哪些教师支持与更充分的视觉输入相关，并让这种区分直接参与训练。
由此，评估与优化形成连接：对模态使用的诊断，进一步成为选择更新的依据。更广泛的问题，是这一标准在不同图像变换、任务与模型家族中，何时仍能稳定对应有用的证据。
zh.deck: 通过视觉教师对照，选择获得更强图像证据支持的自蒸馏词元。

title.en: V-FIND: Revealing the Intrinsic Forgery Knowledge Encoded in Video Forgery Detectors
title.zh: V-FIND：揭示视频伪造检测器中的内在取证知识

summary.en: A compact set of latent anchor neurons exposes reusable forensic signals inside frozen video forgery detectors.
summary.zh: 在冻结视频伪造检测器中定位紧凑的潜在锚点神经元，提取可复用的取证信号。

We first localize critical layers by complementary layer-wise discrepancy signals, then identify sparse latent anchor neurons within these layers, and finally train a lightweight detector on the resulting compact forensic subspace.

title.zh: 紧凑的取证读出

explanation.en: Layer localization and latent-anchor selection precede linear classification from a frozen backbone.
explanation.zh: 先定位层与潜在锚点，再从冻结骨干的表征中进行线性分类。

figures.caption: Figure 3: Layer-localization signals across 8 fake-source subsets from the detector training distribution.

title.zh: 定位具有判别信息的层

explanation.en: The two discrepancy signals vary with depth across eight fake-source subsets.
explanation.zh: 两类差异信号展示八个伪造来源子集中的逐层变化。

(2026b), except VINA, which is evaluated by us using the released checkpoint of Li et al. (2026a). Ours denotes V-FIND with the selected LAN subspace. Best results are in bold and second best are underlined.

title.zh: 发现设置之外的检测表现
