explanation.zh: 原表比较外部生成视频数据集上的准确率与平均精度。

en.thesis: A detector’s useful forensic knowledge can be studied as an internal representation that survives a new readout.
short: V-FIND asks how much forensic capability can be recovered from a video detector without retraining its backbone. It locates layers that separate authentic and synthetic videos, then identifies sparse latent anchor neurons carrying consistent discriminative signals. These coordinates form a compact forensic subspace.

A lightweight linear classifier reads the selected subspace while the original backbone remains frozen. External benchmarks and neuron interventions test whether those signals are reusable and functionally relevant, connecting internal localization to observable detection behavior.
en.motivation: Optimizing a detector as a black box reveals little about which of its learned signals support generalization. Sparse internal localization offers a way to examine the knowledge already present before allocating the cost of further full-model adaptation.
method: Locate critical layers using complementary discrepancies between real and forged video representations.
Select latent anchor neurons from the localized layers and assemble a compact subspace.
Train a linear readout with the backbone frozen, then test external generalization and targeted neuron interventions.
en.evidence: The selected results show layer-localization signals and detection comparisons on external generated-video benchmarks. The study also uses fixed-budget controls, depth restrictions, cross-architecture checks, and paired activation swaps to examine whether the selected units contribute beyond a favorable feature budget.
takeaway: The work turns a trained detector into a source of inspectable and potentially reusable knowledge. A successful sparse readout helps separate the capacity stored in a representation from the particular classifier that originally exposed it.

Generalization still depends on which distinctions those coordinates capture. External-generator tests and activation swaps make that question more concrete: they examine both where the signal transfers and how changing the selected representation changes the decision.
en.deck: A compact set of latent anchor neurons exposes reusable forensic signals inside frozen video forgery detectors.

zh.thesis: 检测器的取证知识，可以通过更换读出后仍然有效的内部表征来研究。
short: V-FIND 追问：不重新训练骨干，能够从视频检测器中提取多少取证能力？方法先定位能够区分真实与合成视频的关键层，再识别持续携带判别信号的稀疏潜在锚点神经元，构成紧凑的取证子空间。
原骨干保持冻结，仅训练轻量线性分类器读取选定子空间。外部基准与神经元干预共同检验这些信号是否可复用、是否与检测行为存在功能联系。
zh.motivation: 将检测器作为黑箱优化，难以说明哪些已学信号支撑了泛化。内部稀疏定位使研究者能够在继续投入整模型适配之前，先分析模型已经拥有的取证知识。
method: 结合真实与伪造视频表征之间的互补差异，定位关键层。
在这些层中选择潜在锚点神经元，构成紧凑判别子空间。
冻结骨干训练线性读出，再通过外部分布和定向干预检验其作用。
zh.evidence: 所选图表展示逐层定位信号与外部生成视频基准上的检测比较。论文还通过同预算控制、深度限制、跨架构检验及成对激活交换，分析收益是否来自选定单元本身。
takeaway: 这项工作将已训练的检测器视为可检查、可复用知识的来源。稀疏读出的有效性，有助于区分表征中储存的判别能力与原分类头实际暴露出来的能力。
泛化仍取决于这些坐标捕捉了什么差异。外部生成器测试与激活交换，使这一问题能够同时从迁移范围和决策变化两个角度接受检验。
zh.deck: 在冻结视频伪造检测器中定位紧凑的潜在锚点神经元，提取可复用的取证信号。

title.en: ReflectRL: Learning from Golden Negative Trajectories via Reflective-to-Direct Reasoning
title.zh: ReflectRL：从专家失败轨迹中学习，将反思迁移为直接推理

summary.en: Flawed expert trajectories become material for reflection, then a policy transition transfers the benefit to direct reasoning.
summary.zh: 将专家失败轨迹转化为反思材料，再通过策略过渡把收益迁移到直接推理。

papers.authors: Bi Jinhe, Zhou Chennan, Jin Zengjie, Aniri, Lu Shuo, Huang Wenke, Cao Hu, Xiao Xun, Zhu Zhihong, Tresp Volker, Shen Fei, Ma Yunpu, Chua Tat-Seng

figures.caption: Figure 2 Overview of ReflectRL. A failed expert trajectory is used as a Golden Negative Trajectory to elicit Reflective Reasoning. ReflectRL combines Reflective Reasoning with Direct Reasoning during on-policy training and applies Reflective-to-Direct Policy Transition to transfer the acquired reasoning behavior back to the original problem setting.

title.en: From flawed guidance to independent reasoning
title.zh: 从失败指导到独立推理

explanation.en: The framework combines golden negative trajectories, reflective reasoning, and a transition back to direct reasoning.
explanation.zh: 框架结合黄金负轨迹、反思推理与向直接推理的策略过渡。

figures.caption: Figure 1 Understanding the Reflection Advantage through behavioral, descriptive, and intervention evidence on Qwen2.5-Math-7B. (a) Behavioral Evidence: Reflection Gain ∆ref = Eo∼π[r(q, o) | q, o−] −Eo∼π[r(q, o) | q] over training steps. Reflecting on a GNT yields the largest gain, which steadily grows during training, whereas self-failures offer limited benefits, and weak-model failures or mismatched GNT (incase length bias) leads to negative gain. (b) Descriptive Evidence: Qwen2.5-Math-PRM-7B score profiles of failure sources and process metrics (inset). GNT maintains a higher valid prefix of reasoning compared to other failure sources before dropping at localized error points. (c) Intervention Evidence: Ablation of GNT trajectory components. Both the valid prefix and the error region causally drive the reflection gain, whereas removing these components (Shuffled GNT, Answer Only) reduces accuracy below the direct baseline.

title.zh: 检验反思优势

explanation.en: Behavioral, descriptive, and intervention analyses investigate what information failed trajectories provide.
explanation.zh: 行为、描述与干预分析共同考察失败轨迹提供了什么信息。

figures.caption: Table 1 Overall in-distribution (ID) and out-of-distribution (OOD) performance comparison on Qwen2.5-Math-7B. ReflectRL consistently boosts existing on-policy post-training baselines (GRPO, DAPO, and OPD) in both ID and OOD scenarios, achieving competitive performance compared to previous zero-RL paradigms under a lightweight training recipe.

title.zh: 分布内与未见任务表现

explanation.en: The source table compares training methods with and without ReflectRL on ID and OOD benchmarks.
explanation.zh: 原表比较是否加入 ReflectRL 时的分布内与分布外基准表现。

en.thesis: A failed expert attempt can retain useful structure when the learning objective rewards repairing it.
short: ReflectRL studies expert trajectories that fail on difficult questions. Such trajectories need not be treated as correct demonstrations to contain useful information: they can provide a partially productive route that is easier to inspect and repair than to recreate from scratch. The study calls this setting a Reflection Advantage.

The framework uses these golden negative trajectories to elicit reflective reasoning, then transitions the policy back toward direct reasoning. This separates the information useful during training from the behavior desired when the trained model answers independently.
en.motivation: Trajectory-guided training loses supervision precisely where expert models also struggle. Discarding every failed attempt can remove intermediate reasoning structure that might still help a learner identify and resolve the difficult part.
method: Collect failed expert trajectories as material for reflection rather than as targets to imitate.
Combine reflective and direct reasoning within on-policy training.
Apply a reflective-to-direct policy transition so the acquired behavior transfers to answering without trajectory guidance.
en.evidence: Experiments span nine benchmarks, four language-model backbones, and four on-policy training methods. Behavioral and intervention analyses examine the reflection advantage; training dynamics, ablations, and policy-transition comparisons test how the guidance affects learning and later direct reasoning.
takeaway: This changes the role of a negative example from a scalar signal of failure to an object with potentially reusable structure. Learning can ask which parts remain informative, where the reasoning breaks, and how a successful continuation differs.

The policy transition addresses a second challenge: supervision should improve the model’s own competence rather than create permanent dependence on privileged context. Studying both stages helps distinguish gains from access to an expert attempt and gains that persist in the model’s independent reasoning.
en.deck: Flawed expert trajectories become material for reflection, then a policy transition transfers the benefit to direct reasoning.

zh.thesis: 当学习目标鼓励修复错误时，一条失败的专家轨迹仍可能保留有用结构。
short: ReflectRL 研究专家模型在困难问题上的失败轨迹。轨迹即使不能作为正确示范，也可能保留部分有效路线，使检查和修复比从头求解更容易；工作将这种现象称为反思优势。
框架先利用这些“黄金负轨迹”引导反思推理，再将策略过渡回直接推理，由此区分训练时有用的信息与模型独立回答时需要形成的行为。
zh.motivation: 轨迹引导训练往往会在专家也遇到困难的问题上失去监督。丢弃全部失败尝试，可能同时丢掉能够帮助学习者定位并解决难点的中间推理结构。
method: 收集专家失败轨迹，将其作为反思材料，而非模仿目标。
在同策略训练中结合反思与直接推理。
通过反思到直接推理的策略过渡，使收益迁移到不依赖轨迹指导的回答。
zh.evidence: 实验覆盖九个基准、四类语言模型骨干和四种同策略训练方法。行为与干预分析考察反思优势，训练动态、模块消融及策略过渡比较则检验指导如何影响学习与后续直接推理。
takeaway: 这项工作将负样本从一个失败标签，扩展为可能包含可复用结构的研究对象。学习可以进一步回答：哪些部分仍有信息，错误发生在哪里，成功的后续推理又需要改变什么？
策略过渡处理了第二个关键问题：额外上下文应当提升模型自身能力。联合考察两个阶段，有助于区分读取专家尝试带来的收益，与已经保留在模型独立推理中的收益。
zh.deck: 将专家失败轨迹转化为反思材料，再通过策略过渡把收益迁移到直接推理。

title.en: No Single Neuron of Failure: Distributed Safety Alignment Against White-Box Attacks
title.zh: 安全不应依赖单一神经元：面向白盒攻击的分布式安全对齐

summary.en: Distributed safety alignment trains compensatory capacity instead of concentrating refusal behavior in a fragile internal bottleneck.
summary.zh: 通过分布式安全对齐训练补偿能力，减少拒答行为对脆弱内部瓶颈的依赖。

papers.authors: Xie Simiao, Shi Chuancheng, Li Shangze, Wu Wenhua, Shen Fei, Zhou Ying, Wang Zhiyong, Chua Tat-Seng

figures.caption: Fig. 2. Overall framework of distributed safety alignment (DSA). DSA localizes core refusal neurons using direction-aware Taylor scores, then applies targeted masking and stochastic dropout during realignment. Through joint optimization, this structured perturbation forces the model to redundantly encode safety across compensatory neurons.

title.zh: 训练分布式安全支持

explanation.en: Refusal-neuron localization is followed by alignment with targeted masking and stochastic dropout.
explanation.zh: 定位拒答神经元后，通过定向屏蔽与随机失活进行对齐。

figures.caption: Fig. 6. Evolution of redundant safety pathways on Qwen2.5-7B. As successive white-box attacks completely prune currently dominant refusal neurons, DSA sustains robustness by dynamically recruiting compensatory neuron routes across different layer groups.

title.zh: 追踪补偿路径

explanation.en: The visualization tracks refusal-related components recruited after successive internal disruptions.
explanation.zh: 可视化展示连续内部干预后重新参与拒答的成分。

figures.caption: Fig. 4. Ablation study of DSA on Qwen2.5-7B. Left: training variants under FULL pruning. Right: refusal-neuron localization criteria. Bars report ASR out of 313 prompts, while diamonds denote ARC utility.

title.zh: 哪些设计发挥了作用？

explanation.en: Ablations compare training perturbations and localization criteria under a fixed evaluation protocol.
explanation.zh: 消融实验在统一评估下比较训练扰动与定位标准。

en.thesis: A safety mechanism becomes more resilient when its useful computation has trained alternatives.
short: Distributed Safety Alignment examines a vulnerability of open-weight models: an attacker who can manipulate internal neurons may disable a narrow refusal mechanism. DSA first uses activation and loss-gradient information to locate refusal-related FFN coordinates, then perturbs those coordinates during realignment.

Targeted masking and stochastic dropout encourage the model to recruit compensatory capacity. The objective is to make refusal less dependent on a small, easily disrupted set of components, while retaining the language and multimodal abilities that make the model useful.
en.motivation: High refusal accuracy on an intact model does not reveal how concentrated the underlying mechanism is. If a small intervention can remove most of that behavior, ordinary output evaluations can overstate the robustness of the alignment.
method: Localize refusal-related FFN coordinates with a direction-aware first-order Taylor score combining activations and loss gradients.
Apply targeted deterministic masking and stochastic dropout during safety realignment.
Evaluate disruption of dominant and compensatory neurons alongside general language and multimodal utility.
en.evidence: The paper compares robustness under neuron-pruning attacks, studies the contribution of masking and dropout, and tracks newly recruited refusal routes under successive disruptions. Its quantitative ablations pair attack success rates with ARC utility, making robustness and capability preservation visible together.
takeaway: The study connects interpretability to fault tolerance. Finding a compact mechanism can help explain a behavior, while also revealing where that behavior is fragile. Training alternative computational support turns that diagnosis into a concrete alignment objective.

Redundancy is useful when the alternatives preserve the intended decision rather than merely move the same dependency. Successive-intervention analyses help test that distinction. The reported robustness is defined by the tested attacks and budgets, motivating broader adaptive evaluations of the trained alternatives.
en.deck: Distributed safety alignment trains compensatory capacity instead of concentrating refusal behavior in a fragile internal bottleneck.

zh.thesis: 当关键安全计算拥有经过训练的替代路径，模型才更有机会抵抗内部机制失效。
short: Distributed Safety Alignment 研究开放权重模型的一类脆弱性：能够操作内部神经元的攻击者，可能通过干预狭窄的拒答机制使安全行为失效。DSA 先结合激活与损失梯度定位拒答相关的 FFN 坐标，再在重新对齐过程中扰动这些坐标。
定向屏蔽与随机失活共同促使模型利用补偿能力，使拒答减少对少数易受攻击成分的依赖，同时保留一般语言与多模态能力。
zh.motivation: 完整模型上较高的拒答率，无法说明支撑拒答的内部机制是否过于集中。如果少量干预就能移除大部分防护，仅观察正常输出可能高估安全对齐的稳健程度。
method: 结合激活与损失梯度，以方向感知的一阶 Taylor 评分定位拒答相关 FFN 坐标。
在安全重新对齐中结合定向确定性屏蔽与随机失活。
通过对主导和补偿成分的干预，联合检验安全稳健性与一般能力。
zh.evidence: 论文比较神经元剪除攻击下的防护表现，消融屏蔽与随机失活的作用，并追踪连续干预后新出现的拒答路径。定量分析同时报告攻击成功率与 ARC 等一般能力指标。
takeaway: 这项研究将可解释分析与容错设计联系起来。定位紧凑机制既能帮助解释行为，也可能暴露行为的脆弱点；训练替代计算支持，使这种诊断进一步成为可优化的对齐目标。
冗余的价值，在于替代成分能够继续支撑正确决策。连续干预分析有助于检验这一点，并区分形成有效补偿与简单移动依赖。现有稳健性结论对应论文中的攻击与预算，更广泛的自适应检验仍然重要。
zh.deck: 通过分布式安全对齐训练补偿能力，减少拒答行为对脆弱内部瓶颈的依赖。

title.en: Moving the Safety Barrier: Dynamic Routing Adaptive Alignment Against White-Box Attacks
title.zh: 移动安全屏障：面向白盒攻击的动态路由自适应对齐

summary.en: Failure-aware preference learning trains compensatory safety routes when a dominant refusal route is disrupted.
summary.zh: 根据内部失效构造偏好监督，在主导拒答路径受损时训练补偿安全路径。

papers.authors: Li Shangze, Shi Chuancheng, Xie Simiao, He Lingzhi, Ji Cheng, Cheng Zifeng, Shen Fei, Wu Chao, Chua Tat-Seng

figures.caption: Fig. 2. Overall framework of dynamic routing adaptive alignment (DRAA). (§3.2) DRAA first contrasts internal activations between safe and unsafe samples to localize the safety route. (§3.3) It then temporarily masks this route to simulate causal defense failures, constructing failure-aware preference pairs. (§3.4) Finally, DR-DPO locks the safety route during optimization, forcing the model to reconstruct compensatory safety routes within the unrestricted parameter space.

title.zh: 从内部失效中学习

explanation.en: The pipeline localizes a route, mines failure-aware preferences, and trains compensatory routing.
explanation.zh: 流程依次定位路径、挖掘失效偏好对，并训练补偿路由。

figures.caption: Fig. 5. Double-lesion diagnostic on VL-Question using Qwen2.5-VL-7B. This diagnostic applies a fixed shared FULL route, unlike the model-specific re-localization in Table III. The ASR increase under FULL+JUMP supports the compensatory role of activation-jump neurons.

title.zh: 检验补偿机制假设

explanation.en: The double-lesion diagnostic compares the original, route-pruned, and route-plus-compensation-pruned conditions.
explanation.zh: 双重损伤实验比较完整、原路径受损，以及原路径与补偿成分同时受损的情况。

figures.caption: Fig. 6. Visualization of route redundancy in Qwen2.5-7B. Upon disruption of the safety route, DRAA actively strengthens latent compensatory routes to ensure robust safety recovery.

title.zh: 替代支持出现在哪里？

explanation.en: The visualization traces identified route components before and after intervention.
explanation.zh: 可视化追踪干预前后识别到的路径成分。

en.thesis: A resilient safety boundary depends on how the model responds when its usual route to refusal is unavailable.
short: Dynamic Routing Adaptive Alignment localizes a model’s existing safety route and temporarily disrupts it to collect defense failures. Those failures become preference pairs for learning alternatives. During optimization, the identified route is locked so that updates must recruit compensatory computation elsewhere.

The framework therefore trains against an internal counterfactual: what should the model do when its preferred safety route is compromised? Route-level diagnostics then examine whether the resulting robustness is actually supported by the proposed compensation.
en.motivation: A static refusal pathway can become a predictable target in an open-weight model. Ordinary safety training may reinforce the same dependency, leaving unclear whether the model can preserve its behavior after that pathway is attacked.
method: Contrast safe and unsafe internal activations to identify the model’s safety route.
Mask that route and mine the resulting failures to construct failure-aware preference pairs.
Apply dynamic-routing DPO with the original route locked, encouraging compensatory support outside it.
en.evidence: The paper reports safety and utility under route-level pruning across language and multimodal models. A double-lesion diagnostic disrupts both the original route and identified compensatory components; the additional degradation supports the compensation account within that test. Route visualizations and ablations examine how the alternatives emerge.
takeaway: This reframes alignment as preparation for changes to the model’s internal operating conditions. Deliberately producing a known mechanism failure can supply targeted supervision about the behavior that must survive, turning interpretability into a way to construct useful training data.

The crucial question is whether the learned alternatives remain effective under new interventions. Joint route-disruption tests are valuable because they challenge the proposed mechanism directly. They also help distinguish a demonstrated compensatory route from a broad claim of immunity to arbitrary white-box changes.
en.deck: Failure-aware preference learning trains compensatory safety routes when a dominant refusal route is disrupted.

zh.thesis: 安全边界能否保持，取决于模型在常用拒答路径不可用时如何继续决策。
short: Dynamic Routing Adaptive Alignment 先定位既有安全路径，再通过临时扰动收集防御失效。这些失效被构造成偏好对；优化时锁定原有路径，促使更新在其他位置形成补偿计算。
框架由此围绕一种内部反事实开展训练：当常用安全路径受损时，模型应如何继续维持正确拒答？路径层诊断进一步检验，得到的稳健性是否确实由所提出的补偿机制支撑。
zh.motivation: 在开放权重模型中，固定拒答路径可能成为可预测的攻击目标。常规安全训练可能继续增强相同依赖，因此需要检验模型在该路径受损后，能否仍然维持预期行为。
method: 对比安全与不安全样本的内部激活，识别模型的安全路径。
屏蔽该路径，并利用产生的防御失败构造失效感知偏好对。
通过锁定原路径的动态路由 DPO 优化，促使其他位置形成补偿支持。
zh.evidence: 论文在语言与多模态模型上比较路径剪除后的安全性与一般能力。双重损伤实验同时干预原路径和补偿成分，额外退化为该设置下的补偿解释提供支持；路径可视化和消融进一步分析替代计算如何形成。
takeaway: 这项工作将对齐理解为对内部运行条件变化的准备。主动构造已知机制失效，可以生成关于“哪些行为必须继续成立”的定向监督，让可解释分析参与训练数据的设计。
关键仍在于，这些替代计算面对新的内部干预是否有效。联合路径损伤实验能够直接挑战机制假设，也帮助区分已经验证的补偿路径与对任意白盒修改均有效的更强主张。

highlights.label: 从路径扰动中获得监督

zh.deck: 根据内部失效构造偏好监督，在主导拒答路径受损时训练补偿安全路径。

title.en: SafeNexus: Discovering and Steering Modality-Universal Safety Neurons in MLLMs
title.zh: SafeNexus：发现并引导多模态模型的跨模态共享安全神经元

summary.en: Locating modality-universal safety neurons connects cross-modal diagnosis to activation steering and targeted calibration.
summary.zh: 定位跨模态共享安全神经元，将机制诊断连接到激活引导与定向校准。

papers.authors: Yu Jian, Shen Fei, Wang Cong, Wang Jian, Jin Lu, Du Xiaoyu, Tang Jinhui, Chua Tat-Seng

figures.caption: Figure 2: Overview of the SafeNexus framework. (a) Neuron Localization. We identify neurons associated with specific functionalities by analyzing activation magnitudes within the FFN and deriving corresponding importance scores to quantify their contributions. (b) Safety-Neuron Seeking. We identify BS-Neurons via contrastive activation analysis, and define US- Neurons as US = BST ∩BSI ∩BSA. (c) Neuron-Guided Safety Steering. For US-Neurons, we propose two alignment strategies: an activation-level safety amplifier that strengthens their corresponding activation magnitudes, and a safety neuron calibrator that performs targeted parameter refinement.

title.zh: 定位、求交与引导

explanation.en: The framework links neuron localization to modality-universal safety sets and two steering strategies.
explanation.zh: 框架将神经元定位连接到跨模态共享集合和两类安全引导策略。

figures.caption: Table 2: Validation of US-Neurons. Comparison of masking random neurons (M-R) and US-Neurons (M-US) in terms of safety performance and utility. We report the average ASR on Omni-Safe across all modality combinations.

title.zh: 检验共享单元的作用

explanation.en: The original table compares safety and utility after random masking or shared-neuron suppression.
explanation.zh: 原表比较随机屏蔽与共享单元抑制之后的安全性及一般能力。

figures.caption: Table 3: Quantitative comparison of attack success rate (ASR ↓) on multiple safety benchmarks. Amp. and Cal. denote the activation-level safety amplifier and safety neuron calibrator. Right-side deltas are relative to the original model, with green and red indicating improvement and degradation. Bold and underlined values mark the best and second-best results.

title.zh: 两条安全增强路线

explanation.en: Benchmark results compare activation amplification and learned calibration with multimodal defense baselines.
explanation.zh: 基准结果将激活放大和学习校准与多模态防御基线比较。

en.thesis: A cross-modal defense needs a mechanism that remains relevant when the source of risk changes modality.
short: SafeNexus first identifies safety-related neurons for individual modality settings, then studies their shared intersection. Targeted suppression examines whether these modality-universal neurons influence safety across input combinations, connecting their overlap to observable behavior.

The same coordinates support two interventions: an inference-time activation amplifier and a calibrator that selectively fine-tunes them. These are distinct adaptation routes, allowing the study to compare direct activation control with learned changes to the shared safety mechanism.
en.motivation: Extending a language model to images, audio, or combined inputs changes how risks enter the computation. A defense that works for one modality may fail to engage when the same harmful intent reaches the model through another interface.
method: Localize functionality-related FFN neurons from intermediate activations and importance scores.
Identify modality-bound safety sets and test the functional relevance of their shared intersection.
Compare activation amplification with targeted calibration on safety, utility, and over-refusal measurements.
en.evidence: Masking modality-universal neurons degrades safety across the tested modality combinations more than matched random controls. The paper evaluates an amplifier and a calibrator on several multimodal models and benchmarks, with additional checks on general capabilities, over-refusal, and transfer to video-related settings.
takeaway: The study treats cross-modal consistency as a property of an identifiable internal mechanism. That makes it possible to ask whether a failure comes from missing safety knowledge, limited access to a shared mechanism, or a modality-specific route that does not engage it effectively.

The two intervention routes also clarify the cost of control: changing activations and learning parameter updates solve different adaptation problems. Their comparison can inform when a compact shared target is sufficient, and when broader or differently localized alignment is needed.
en.deck: Locating modality-universal safety neurons connects cross-modal diagnosis to activation steering and targeted calibration.

zh.thesis: 跨模态防御需要一种在风险输入模态变化后，仍然发挥作用的内部机制。
short: SafeNexus 先识别各模态设置中的安全相关神经元，再研究这些集合的共享交集。定向抑制用于检验跨模态共享单元能否影响不同输入组合的安全表现，使集合重叠与实际行为建立联系。
同一组坐标进一步支持两类干预：推理时的激活放大器，以及选择性微调这些单元的校准器。二者分别对应直接激活控制与学习得到的机制调整，适配成本和作用方式有所不同。
zh.motivation: 从语言模型扩展到图像、音频及其组合后，风险进入内部计算的方式会发生变化。某一模态中的防护有效，并不意味着相同意图通过另一种输入接口时仍能触发同样的安全机制。
method: 根据中间激活与重要性评分，定位与目标功能相关的 FFN 神经元。
识别模态特定安全集合，并检验共享交集的功能作用。
比较激活放大与定向校准，联合测量安全、一般能力及过度拒答。
zh.evidence: 在所测试的模态组合中，抑制共享安全单元比随机对照造成更明显的安全退化。论文还在多种多模态模型与基准上比较两类干预，并检查一般能力、过度拒答及视频场景迁移。
takeaway: 这项研究将跨模态一致性连接到可识别的内部机制，使失效能够被进一步拆解：是安全知识不足、共享机制调用不充分，还是某条模态特有路径没有有效接入这些机制？这些解释可以对应不同的干预实验。
两种干预方式也明确了控制的成本：改变激活与学习参数更新，处理的是不同的适配问题。对它们的比较，有助于判断紧凑共享目标何时已经足够，以及何时需要更广或不同位置的对齐。
zh.deck: 定位跨模态共享安全神经元，将机制诊断连接到激活引导与定向校准。

title.en: One Anchor for All: Unified Multilingual and Multimodal Safety Alignment for LVLMs
title.zh: 一个锚点，贯通语言与模态：LVLM 统一安全对齐

summary.en: A compact intersection of language- and modality-shared neurons transfers English safety supervision to compound input settings.
summary.zh: 利用语言与模态共享神经元的紧凑交集，将英语安全监督迁移到复合输入场景。

papers.authors: Shi Enyi, Shen Fei, Shi Chuancheng, Zhu Linxia, Miao Shuyi, Tang Jinhui, Chua Tat-Seng

figures.caption: Figure 2: Framework Overview. § 3.2 Input and Neuron Probing. Using multilingual and multimodal probing datasets, we identify monolingual and unimodal safety neurons per language under Image- and Text-Dominant Risks. § 3.3 Cross-Lingual and Modal Safety Neurons. Within each language, neurons responsive to both visual and textual risks are extracted as MS- Neurons and aligned across languages, with English anchoring the identification of MLS-Neurons. § 3.4 MLS-Targeted Safety Tuning. Targeted tuning on MLS-Neurons transfers supervision from English-only safety data across languages and modalities.

title.en: A shared target across two dimensions
title.zh: 两个维度上的共享目标

explanation.en: Neuron probing is followed by cross-modal and cross-language intersection and selective tuning.
explanation.zh: 神经元探测后进行跨模态与跨语言交集提取，再实施选择性微调。

figures.caption: Figure 4: Impact of Different Masking Strategies on Model Safety. Masking MLS-Neurons leads to a substan- tially larger increase in ASR than masking Random-Neurons or language-specific monolingual MS\MLS-Neurons, indi- cating that MLS-Neurons play a critical role for model safety.

title.zh: 干预共享交集

explanation.en: Masking strategies produce different safety effects for image-dominant and text-dominant risks.
explanation.zh: 不同屏蔽策略对图像主导与文本主导风险产生不同的安全影响。

figures.caption: Table 2: ASR across In-Distribution Languages. Our method outperforms all baselines on average across in-distribution languages and risk modalities for all three LVLMs, demonstrating the effectiveness and robustness of our method.

title.zh: 语言—模态组合中的安全表现

explanation.en: The original table compares attack success rates on three LVLMs under both risk modalities.
explanation.zh: 原表比较三种 LVLM 在两类风险模态下的攻击成功率。

en.thesis: Cross-language and cross-modal safety can be studied through the internal mechanism the two dimensions share.
short: One Anchor for All addresses safety when visual evidence and multilingual instructions interact. It first identifies safety-related neurons within each language and modality, then extracts modality-shared neurons and their intersection across languages. English serves as the anchor for identifying a compact shared subset.

Alignment updates only that selected subset, reported at roughly 0.03% of parameters. The study asks whether English-only safety supervision can improve protection across the combined language and modality settings, instead of requiring equally extensive supervision for every combination.
en.motivation: Evaluating language and modality separately can miss failures that emerge when they interact. Fully covering every combination is expensive, so a useful alignment target should connect the two dimensions while preserving general multimodal competence.
method: Probe neuron saliency using harmful and benign examples in each language and modality.
Intersect modality-specific sets within languages, then identify language-shared coordinates using an English anchor.
Selectively update the shared subset and evaluate both familiar and held-out language–modality settings.
en.evidence: Neuron masking tests compare shared coordinates with random and language-specific controls. Evaluations cover three LVLMs, in-distribution and held-out languages, general capabilities, and over-refusal. The selected results show how safety changes depend on which internal subset is masked or trained.
takeaway: The work makes supervision reuse a mechanistic question: where can evidence from one setting change behavior in another? A shared internal target offers a concrete answer that can be probed before allocating the cost of alignment across many input combinations.

The intersection is an empirical object whose usefulness depends on the model, probing data, and anchor language. Studying those dependencies is as important as measuring its compactness, because a small update becomes valuable when it transfers the intended behavior while retaining useful capabilities.
en.deck: A compact intersection of language- and modality-shared neurons transfers English safety supervision to compound input settings.

zh.thesis: 跨语言与跨模态安全，可以从两个维度共同使用的内部机制出发研究。
short: One Anchor for All 面向视觉信息与多语言指令共同作用时的安全问题。方法先识别各语言、各模态中的安全相关神经元，再提取模态共享单元及其跨语言交集，并以英语为锚点定位紧凑的共享子集。
对齐仅更新选定子集，论文报告的参数规模约为 0.03%。研究进一步检验，仅使用英语安全监督，能否改善不同语言与模态组合中的防护，从而提高有限监督的复用效率。
zh.motivation: 分别研究语言和模态，可能遗漏两者交互形成的失效。逐一覆盖所有组合又成本较高，因此需要寻找能够连接两个维度、同时保留一般多模态能力的内部对齐目标。
method: 通过良性与有害样本的响应，对各语言、各模态的神经元功能显著性进行测量。
先在语言内部提取模态共享集合，再以英语为锚点识别跨语言共享坐标。
选择性更新共享子集，联合评估已见与未见的语言—模态组合。
zh.evidence: 屏蔽实验将共享坐标与随机、语言特有成分进行对照。评估覆盖三个 LVLM、分布内及未见语言、一般能力与过度拒答，展示屏蔽或训练不同内部子集时的行为变化。
takeaway: 这项工作将监督复用具体化为机制问题：一种设置中的证据，能够通过哪些内部位置影响另一种设置的行为？共享目标使这一问题能够在大规模分配对齐成本之前接受检验。
共享交集的作用，取决于模型、探测数据与锚点语言。刻画这些条件与测量集合大小同样重要；小规模更新的真正价值，在于它能够迁移预期行为，并保留模型原有的有效能力。

title.en: Decodable Is Not Grounded: A Vision-Ablation Arbiter for VLM Spatial Reasoning
title.zh: 能解码，不等于有视觉依据：VLM 空间推理的视觉消融裁决

summary.en: Image ablation separates visually grounded knowledge, directional priors, and representations deployed with the wrong sign.
summary.zh: 通过图像消融，区分视觉依据、方向先验与被错误使用的表征。

papers.authors: Liao Chih-Ting, Shen Fei, Cao Xin, Chua Tat-Seng

figures.caption: Figure 1: Decodability does not predict whether behavior depends on the image. Each point is a (model, axis) pair across 8 VLMs: x is probe decoding accuracy, y is vision-dependence (real- image −gray-image behavior). Probes decode every axis well (x>70%), but behavior splits into three regimes probing cannot see: horizontal grounded (high), vertical a prior (zero), depth inverted (below zero). The arbiter recovers this in one forward pass. Percentages.

title.en: Decodability and visual dependence can diverge
title.zh: 可解码性与视觉依赖可能分离

explanation.en: Each point relates probe accuracy to the behavioral effect of removing the image.
explanation.zh: 每个点将探针准确率与移除图像后的行为变化联系起来。

figures.caption: Figure 2: The recovery is prior amplification, not visual deployment. Training-free projection along the localized vertical direction lifts vertical from 58.5 to 79 at γ = 2 with horizontal intact. But the same projection with a gray-blank image (dashed) gains just as much (+19.1 vs. +20.5): the lever amplifies a non-visual prior. An off-band projection (L2–6, dotted) does nothing. Percentages.

title.zh: 引导是否恢复了视觉证据？

explanation.en: The plot compares steering with real and blank images to test whether recovery depends on vision.
explanation.zh: 对比真实与空白图像下的引导结果，检验收益是否依赖视觉。

figures.caption: Figure 3: The grounding taxonomy as a cross-model card. Real-image accuracy on the three ViewSpatial axes for 14 VLMs (six LM families, 2B–27B), each cell colored by its arbiter regime. At a glance: horizontal grounded, vertical a prior, depth inverted in every capable model, with depth inversion scale-emergent within families (InternVL3 38 →31 →28; Gemma non-monotone 53→43→46); SmolVLM-2.2B is a capability floor. Percentages.

title.zh: 跨模型的视觉依据卡片

explanation.en: The original matrix summarizes spatial-axis behavior and grounding regimes across fourteen VLMs.
explanation.zh: 原始矩阵总结十四个 VLM 在不同空间轴上的行为与视觉依据状态。

en.thesis: Decoding or steering a representation does not establish that the model used the image to make the decision.
short: This study examines a familiar interpretability signature: a probe decodes the answer, and steering improves performance. In VLM spatial reasoning, that combination can conceal a directional prior that persists when the image is replaced by a gray blank. The apparent recovery can therefore overstate visual grounding.

The vision-ablation arbiter separates three regimes: grounded and correct, vision-independent prior, and visually dependent but inverted deployment. In the last regime, information is decodable and behavior is controllable, yet the model uses the relevant direction with the wrong sign.
en.motivation: A model can expose a linearly decodable label without using the intended evidence in its deployed computation. Demonstrating that a representation exists and can affect output leaves a further question: does its behavioral effect depend on the visual input?
method: Compare spatial-task behavior with probe decodability and controlled representation interventions.
Replace or disrupt the visual input while retaining the task, using blank-image and additional ablation controls.
Classify the resulting grounding regime and examine which minimal representation edit corrects inverted deployment.
en.evidence: The study examines fourteen VLMs across six language-model families and separates grounding regimes across spatial axes. Additional tests compare several vision ablations and investigate decode-versus-deploy inversion across model families. Intervention results show that the correction needed can range from a training-free rotation to a learned low-rank edit, depending on representation geometry.
takeaway: The work separates four pieces of evidence that are easy to conflate: information can be decoded, an intervention can control output, the output can be correct, and the decision can depend on the image. A stronger account of latent knowledge needs to state which of these has actually been demonstrated.

This makes a simple counterfactual especially valuable. Removing visual evidence can challenge an otherwise convincing probe-and-steering story, while additional ablation controls test whether the result reflects an artifact of the blank input. The broader lesson is to make grounding a measured property of the deployed computation.
en.deck: Image ablation separates visually grounded knowledge, directional priors, and representations deployed with the wrong sign.

zh.thesis: 能够解码或引导一种表征，并不足以证明模型依赖图像作出了决策。
short: 这项研究检验一种常见的可解释性证据组合：探针能够读出答案，表征引导又能改善表现。在 VLM 空间推理中，即使图像被替换为空白，这种“恢复”也可能继续存在，因而高估视觉依据。
视觉消融裁决进一步区分三种情形：有视觉依据且使用正确、不依赖视觉的方向先验，以及依赖视觉却反向使用的部署。在第三种情形中，信息既能被解码、也能被干预控制，模型却以错误符号使用相关方向。
zh.motivation: 模型可能暴露可线性解码的标签，却没有在实际计算中使用预期证据。证明表征存在且能够改变输出之后，还需要继续回答：这种行为影响是否依赖视觉输入？
method: 联合比较空间任务行为、探针可解码性与受控表征干预。
保持任务不变，使用空白图像及其他视觉消融对照，检验对输入证据的依赖。
区分视觉依据状态，并研究修正反向使用所需的最小表征编辑。
zh.evidence: 研究覆盖六类语言模型家族中的十四个 VLM，并按空间轴区分视觉依据状态。其他实验比较多种视觉消融，检验跨模型的解码—使用反向现象；修正方式随表征几何变化，从无需训练的旋转到学习得到的低秩编辑有所不同。
takeaway: 这项工作区分了四类容易混淆的证据：信息能被解码、输出能被干预控制、答案能够正确，以及决策确实依赖图像。更有说服力的潜在知识解释，需要明确自己已经验证了其中哪些环节。
一个简单反事实因而很有价值：移除视觉证据，可以挑战原本看似充分的探针与引导结论；其他消融则检验结果是否只是空白输入的特殊效应。更广泛的启发，是将视觉依据视为实际计算中需要测量的性质。

highlights.label: 视觉依据、先验与反向使用

zh.deck: 通过图像消融，区分视觉依据、方向先验与被错误使用的表征。

papers.authors: Li Shaotian, Li Shangze, Shi Chuancheng, Wu Wenhua, Wu Yanqiu, Yu Xiaohan, Shen Fei, Chua Tat-Seng

title.en: Latent Anomaly Knowledge Excavation: Unveiling Sparse Sensitive Neurons in Vision-Language Models
title.zh: LAKE：挖掘视觉语言模型中的潜在异常知识

summary.en: Excavate anomaly-sensitive neurons already present in a vision-language model using a small set of normal samples.
summary.zh: 利用少量正常样本，挖掘视觉语言模型中已经存在的异常敏感神经元。

en.deck: Excavate anomaly-sensitive neurons already present in a vision-language model using a small set of normal samples.
short: LAKE uses a small collection of normal images to locate anomaly-sensitive units in a frozen vision-language model. Patch-level structural deviations and cross-modal semantic signals are combined into an anomaly score. The backbone supplies the representation; normal examples help identify how that representation should be read.

The approach links localization to detection without gradient-based backbone adaptation. Quantitative evaluations and spatial anomaly maps examine whether the selected signals can identify unfamiliar defects and localize their regions.
en.motivation: Treating a VLM as a black-box feature extractor can obscure which internal signals support anomaly detection. LAKE examines whether those signals can be selected and elicited directly.
method: Use a minimal set of normal samples to identify anomaly-sensitive neurons in the pretrained model.
Isolate the selected signals to construct a compact representation of normality.
Combine visual structural deviations with cross-modal semantic activations for anomaly scoring.
en.evidence: Evaluation on industrial anomaly-detection benchmarks reports strong performance together with neuron-level interpretability. The approach uses normal samples and does not train a new backbone.
takeaway: For anomaly detection, limited defect data is a structural condition of the problem. A useful system must extract diagnostic value from what normality makes observable. LAKE frames that task as selecting and reading pretrained knowledge at the appropriate internal locations.

This gives an interpretable way to study adaptation under scarce evidence: which units normal samples select, what deviations they detect, and how performance changes with the normal support set. The same questions help identify when pretrained knowledge is insufficient for a new inspection environment.
en.thesis: Normal examples can reveal which parts of a pretrained representation are useful for detecting the abnormal.

zh.deck: 利用少量正常样本，挖掘视觉语言模型中已经存在的异常敏感神经元。
short: LAKE 利用少量正常图像，在冻结视觉语言模型中定位异常敏感单元，再将局部结构偏离与跨模态语义信号结合为异常分数。骨干提供已有表征，正常样本则帮助确定应当怎样读取这些表征。
这一方法把内部定位与异常检测连接起来，无需基于梯度适配骨干。定量评估与空间异常图共同检验，选出的信号能否识别陌生缺陷并定位异常区域。
zh.motivation: 将视觉语言模型作为黑箱特征提取器，难以解释哪些内部信号真正支持异常判断。LAKE 进一步研究这些信号能否被直接筛选和激发。
method: 利用少量正常样本，在预训练模型中识别对异常变化敏感的神经元。
分离选中的神经信号，构造紧凑的正常性表示。
联合视觉结构偏离与跨模态语义激活，用于异常评分。
zh.evidence: 工业异常检测基准上的评估报告了较强的检测表现，并提供神经元层面的内部解释。其方法使用正常样本，侧重既有内部信号的筛选与利用，而非重新训练主干。
takeaway: 缺陷样本有限，是异常检测长期面对的任务条件。系统需要从正常状态中提取足够的诊断依据；LAKE 将其具体化为在恰当的内部位置选择和读取预训练知识。
这也为少样本适配提供了可解释的研究路径：正常样本选中了哪些单元、这些单元识别何种偏离、支持集规模又怎样影响结果。围绕这些问题展开分析，也有助于判断预训练知识何时不足以支持新的检测环境。
zh.thesis: 正常样本能够帮助定位预训练表征中对异常真正有诊断价值的部分。

figures.caption: Fig. 2. The LAKE framework. Features from layer l are projected into a variance-filtered sensitive subspace (Isens) and compared against a normal gallery (G) to compute the visual score (Svis). Simultaneously, deeper features (P (l′)) are aligned with text embeddings (tnorm, tanom) to extract the semantic score (Stext). Both scores are fused via weight α to produce the unified anomaly score (S).

title.en: Beyond Surface Artifacts: Capturing Shared Latent Forgery Knowledge Across Modalities
title.zh: 超越表面伪迹：跨模态共享潜在伪造知识

summary.en: Modality-agnostic forensics tests whether a detector can reuse learned forensic structure on an unseen medium.
summary.zh: 通过模态无关取证，检验检测器能否在未知媒介上复用已学判别结构。

papers.authors: Dou Jingtong, Shi Chuancheng, Wang Jian, Shen Fei, Wang Zhiyong, Chua Tat-Seng

figures.caption: Fig. 2. Architecture of the MAF framework. Following training on known modalities, the universal detector F evaluates an unseen modality MK+1 under two settings: Weak MAF utilizes a semantically aligned perceptor, while Strong MAF employs an independent perceptor to assess forensic generalization under strict physical and semantic isolation.

title.en: Separating detector reuse from the perceptor
title.zh: 区分检测器复用与感知器条件

explanation.en: Weak and Strong MAF expose different assumptions about the representation of an unseen modality.
explanation.zh: Weak 与 Strong MAF 明确区分未知模态表征的不同假设。

figures.caption: Fig. 3. Comparison of feature distributions between semantic and forensics spaces. Top (Semantic Space): Forgery features exhibit strong modality dependence and lack shared fingerprints, resulting in isolated distributions across modalities. Bottom (Forensics Space): Through feature decoupling, the distributions of both known and completely unseen modalities converge, successfully achieving cross-modal universality of latent forgery knowledge.

title.zh: 语义对齐与取证对齐

explanation.en: The original visualizations compare modality structure in semantic and forensic feature spaces.
explanation.zh: 原始可视化比较语义空间与取证空间中的模态结构。

figures.caption: Fig. 7. Performance evaluation under Strong MAF across three pre-trained perceptors (ImageBind, LanguageBind, and UniBind). The bar chart illustrates the average accuracy of various detection algorithms across different modalities. The dashed lines represent the overall performance benchmarks for multi-modal learning (MML) and domain generalization (DG) methods, respectively, under each corresponding perceiver.

title.zh: 检验更强的迁移设置

explanation.en: The bars compare detection accuracy in Strong MAF across several perceptors and benchmarks.
explanation.zh: 柱状图比较多种感知器和基准上的 Strong MAF 检测准确率。

en.thesis: Forensic transfer asks what remains informative when the physical medium and its familiar artifacts change.
short: Beyond Surface Artifacts studies forgery detection across modalities rather than only across generators within one medium. Its MAF framework uses modality-specific perceptors and a shared lightweight detector, with regularization intended to reduce dependence on modality-specific style and encourage forensic alignment.

Two evaluation settings separate different transfer conditions. Weak MAF uses semantically aligned perceptors; Strong MAF uses an independently learned perceptor for an unseen modality. In the latter setting, target-modality data can support self-supervised representation learning while the forgery detector itself remains fixed.
en.motivation: A representation aligned for semantics need not align the distinctions relevant to forensics. A detector can therefore appear broadly capable while depending on artifacts tied to the media it has already seen.
method: Encode source modalities with their perceptors and train a shared lightweight forgery detector.
Combine classification with cross-modal regularization to encourage transferable forensic representations.
Evaluate unseen modalities under Weak and Strong MAF, explicitly distinguishing the target perceptor and data assumptions.
en.evidence: DeepModal-Bench compares cross-modality generalization across video, audio, and image settings. The selected figures contrast semantic and forensic feature distributions and report Strong MAF performance across several pretrained perceptors. Further analyses inspect distribution consistency and cross-modal neuron co-activation.
takeaway: This work broadens the unit of generalization from a new generator to a new kind of signal. It invites a more demanding question about detection: which learned distinctions reflect the task, and which merely reflect the medium through which the task was observed?

The two settings make the assumptions of that question visible. Performance with an aligned perceptor and performance with an independently learned target representation support different conclusions. Keeping those conditions explicit is essential when assessing how much forensic knowledge genuinely transfers.
en.deck: Modality-agnostic forensics tests whether a detector can reuse learned forensic structure on an unseen medium.

zh.thesis: 取证迁移需要考察：当物理媒介及其熟悉伪迹变化后，哪些判别信息仍然有效？
short: Beyond Surface Artifacts 将伪造检测的泛化对象，从同一媒介中的新生成器扩展到不同模态。MAF 框架结合模态特定感知器与共享轻量检测器，通过正则化减少对模态风格的依赖，推动面向取证的表征对齐。
两种评估区分不同迁移条件：Weak MAF 使用语义对齐的感知器，Strong MAF 则为未知模态独立学习感知器。在后一种设置中，可利用目标模态数据进行自监督表征学习，而伪造判别器保持固定。
zh.motivation: 面向语义的表征对齐，并不意味着取证所需的细微差异也已经对齐。检测器可能表现出广泛的预测能力，却仍然依赖已经见过的媒介特有伪迹。
method: 通过各模态感知器编码来源数据，并训练共享轻量伪造检测器。
结合分类目标与跨模态正则，鼓励可迁移的取证表征。
在 Weak 与 Strong MAF 中评估未知模态，并明确区分目标感知器和可用数据的假设。
zh.evidence: DeepModal-Bench 比较视频、音频与图像之间的泛化。所选图表对照语义与取证空间的特征分布，并展示不同预训练感知器上的 Strong MAF 结果；其他分析进一步检查分布一致性与跨模态神经元共激活。
takeaway: 这项工作将泛化的基本单位，从新生成器推进到新的信号类型。由此，检测能力需要接受更严格的追问：已学差异中，哪些属于取证任务，哪些仅属于观察任务时所用的媒介？
两种设置也使迁移假设更加清楚。对齐感知器下的表现，与独立目标表征下的表现，能够支持的结论有所不同。持续明确这些条件，才能判断究竟有多少取证知识跨越了模态边界。
zh.deck: 通过模态无关取证，检验检测器能否在未知媒介上复用已学判别结构。

papers.authors: Shi Chuancheng, Wu Wenhua, Shen Fei, Zhu Xiaogang, Hu Kun, Wang Zhiyong

title.en: OrthoEraser: Coupled-Neuron Orthogonal Projection for Concept Erasure
title.zh: OrthoEraser：通过耦合神经元正交投影擦除概念

summary.en: Erase a sensitive concept while explicitly protecting the benign features coupled to the intervention.
summary.zh: 在擦除敏感概念时，显式保护与干预方向耦合的正常特征。

en.deck: Erase a sensitive concept while explicitly protecting the benign features coupled to the intervention.
short: OrthoEraser studies concept erasure through the geometry of entangled features. It locates sensitive neurons and identifies coupled features whose responses overlap with the target. An orthogonal projection constrains the intervention relative to the coupled benign subspace, aiming to suppress the target while reducing collateral changes.

The evaluation pairs removal effectiveness with generation fidelity and feature-level analysis. This makes selectivity a first-class objective: a stronger intervention is useful when its behavioral effect is specific enough to preserve legitimate generation.
en.motivation: Suppressing a whole unit can also remove benign attributes because sensitive and benign semantics need not occupy orthogonal activation spaces.
method: Decompose dense activations with an SAE and identify sensitive units.
Detect coupled benign units that are vulnerable to the proposed intervention.
Project erasure vectors into the coupled units’ null space using analytical orthogonalization.
en.evidence: The paper evaluates erasure precision and preservation of non-sensitive generation together. Reported comparisons support the benefit of explicitly protecting the identified benign subspace.
takeaway: Controllability depends on the resolution of an intervention. When harmful and benign features share directions, indiscriminate suppression can damage both. Geometry provides a way to express which components should change and which should be protected.

The broader lesson is to evaluate editing through a joint account of suppression and preservation. The tested projection offers evidence for a more selective mechanism; its guarantees are limited to the modeled subspace and experimental settings, motivating continued checks for residual behavior and side effects.
en.thesis: Precise concept removal requires understanding what the target shares with the capabilities we want to preserve.

zh.deck: 在擦除敏感概念时，显式保护与干预方向耦合的正常特征。
short: OrthoEraser 从特征纠缠的几何关系出发研究概念擦除。方法定位敏感神经元，并识别与目标响应耦合的特征，再利用正交投影约束干预相对于良性耦合子空间的方向，力求抑制目标并减少附带改变。
评估将移除效果、生成保真度与特征层分析放在一起考察，使选择性成为干预的核心目标。干预强度只有与行为效果的针对性结合，才能体现出对合法生成能力的保护价值。
zh.motivation: 敏感语义与正常语义并不天然处于正交空间。直接抑制整个神经元，可能在去除目标概念的同时损伤正常属性。
method: 利用 SAE 分解稠密激活，识别与待擦除敏感概念相关的单元。
检测可能受到干预影响的耦合正常单元，确定需要保护的子空间。
通过解析正交化，将擦除向量投影到耦合单元的零空间，降低对受保护语义的影响。
zh.evidence: 论文同时评估擦除精度与非敏感生成内容的保留。所报告的对比结果支持了显式保护已识别正常子空间的作用。
takeaway: 可控性的关键之一，是干预能够达到多细的分辨率。当有害与良性特征共享方向时，粗粒度抑制可能同时伤及两者；几何约束则提供了一种表达方式，明确哪些成分应被改变、哪些成分需要被保护。
更广泛的启发是，模型编辑应当同时回答目标行为抑制了多少、相关能力保留了多少。论文为更有选择性的干预机制提供了证据；其保护范围仍取决于所建模的子空间与实验设置，需要继续检查残留行为和其他副作用。
zh.thesis: 精确移除一个概念，需要先理解它与希望保留的能力共享了什么。

papers.authors: Cui Chenhang, Yang Binyun, Shen Fei, Chen Yuxin, Zheng Jingnan, Wang Xiang, Zhang An, Chua Tat-Seng

title.en: Transport and Merge: Cross-Architecture Merging for Large Language Models
title.zh: Transport and Merge：跨架构大语言模型合并

summary.en: Use activation correspondences to transfer knowledge between language models whose architectures do not match.
summary.zh: 利用激活对应关系，在架构不兼容的语言模型之间迁移知识。

en.deck: Use activation correspondences to transfer knowledge between language models whose architectures do not match.
short: Transport and Merge uses optimal transport over activation relationships to establish correspondences between heterogeneous language models. These correspondences guide layer and feature alignment, making cross-architecture weight fusion possible. A small shared input set supplies the evidence needed to connect the two models.

The work evaluates knowledge transfer in low-resource language and domain settings, and explores residual-frozen adaptation after fusion. It separates the problem of finding a functional correspondence from the subsequent problem of integrating the transferred representation.
en.motivation: Conventional merging often assumes compatible architectures. That assumption limits transfer from high-resource source models to heterogeneous targets with limited task or language data.
method: Collect activations from source and target models on a small set of shared inputs.
Solve optimal transport to establish correspondences between heterogeneous neuronal representations.
Use the resulting transport plans to guide direct weight-space fusion.
en.evidence: Experiments across low-resource languages and specialized domains report consistent improvements over the corresponding target models. The transfer uses a small input set to infer the cross-model correspondence.
takeaway: This frames model merging as a problem of translation between internal coordinate systems. Architecture can obscure correspondence even when two models contain related computations; activation relationships provide an empirical bridge across that boundary.

The useful outcome is reusable knowledge under limited adaptation data. Future progress depends on identifying when transport plans preserve function, how shared-input coverage affects the mapping, and whether gains survive beyond the domains that supplied the correspondence evidence.
en.thesis: Transferring knowledge across architectures begins with finding which internal computations correspond.

zh.deck: 利用激活对应关系，在架构不兼容的语言模型之间迁移知识。
short: Transport and Merge 根据激活关系构造最优传输，在异构语言模型之间建立对应，再据此进行层与特征对齐，支持跨架构权重融合。少量共享输入提供连接两个模型所需的经验依据。
工作在低资源语言和领域任务中评估知识迁移，并探索融合后的残差冻结适配，将寻找功能对应与整合迁移表征这两个问题分别处理。
zh.motivation: 常规模型合并通常假设架构兼容。这限制了高资源来源模型向异构目标模型的知识迁移，尤其是在目标语言或任务数据有限时。
method: 在少量共享输入上提取来源模型与目标模型的激活。
利用最优传输建立异构神经表示之间的对应关系。
利用得到的传输计划引导权重空间融合，将来源模型的知识引入目标模型。
zh.evidence: 低资源语言和专业领域上的实验报告了相对对应目标模型的持续改进。跨模型对应关系由少量输入推断得到。
takeaway: 这一视角把模型融合理解为内部坐标系之间的翻译。架构差异可能遮蔽实际存在的功能联系，而激活关系为跨越这种边界提供了可测量的桥梁。
实际价值在于，在适配数据有限时复用已训练模型中的知识。后续关键问题包括：传输计划在什么条件下能够保留功能，共享输入覆盖范围如何影响映射，以及迁移收益能否延伸到建立对应关系之外的任务。
zh.thesis: 跨架构迁移知识，首先需要找到内部计算之间的对应关系。

Given a small dataset D, we extract intermediate activations from a high-resource source model and a low-resource target model with heterogeneous architectures. We then use optimal transport to infer layer- and feature-level correspondences, and leverage the resulting transport plans for direct parameter fusion. Finally, the fused model can be optionally refined via residual-frozen adaptation, where the transferred residuals are kept fixed and only base weights are updated.

explanation.zh: 激活对应关系引导层传输、特征传输与权重融合。

title.en: Who Transfers Safety? Identifying and Targeting Cross-Lingual Shared Safety Neurons
title.zh: 谁在传递安全？定位并干预跨语言共享安全神经元

summary.en: Identify shared safety neurons that connect high-resource and non-high-resource language behaviour.
summary.zh: 识别连接高资源与非高资源语言安全行为的共享安全神经元。

en.deck: Identify shared safety neurons that connect high-resource and non-high-resource language behaviour.
short: This study identifies a small set of safety neurons shared across languages and tests their role through masking and targeted training. Their overlap connects safety behavior in high-resource and non-high-resource languages. SS-Neuron Expansion focuses optimization on the English safety neurons used as a bridge for cross-lingual transfer.

The evidence combines neuron-level interventions with multilingual attack evaluations. This connects an observed language disparity to a candidate internal mechanism, then asks whether training that mechanism improves safety across languages.
en.motivation: A model’s safety behaviour can differ sharply across languages. Understanding which internal components participate in that transfer can guide more focused alignment.
method: Identify monolingual safety neurons and test their role through activation and suppression.
Find the subset shared between high-resource and non-high-resource languages.
Train the selected shared subset with a strategy accounting for language resources and model architecture.
en.evidence: Suppressing shared neurons causes concurrent safety drops in non-high-resource languages, while reinforcement improves cross-lingual consistency. Targeted fine-tuning reports stronger non-high-resource safety than the compared methods while maintaining general capabilities.
takeaway: A multilingual model can share parameters without sharing equally effective access to a safety mechanism. Locating the bridge helps make that distinction concrete and offers a principled target for allocating alignment effort where language coverage is uneven.

The broader research direction is mechanism-aware transfer: first identify what is shared, then test whether strengthening it benefits languages beyond those directly supervised. The quality of that transfer must be assessed together with general usefulness and language-specific failure modes.
en.thesis: Cross-language safety transfer depends on which internal mechanisms languages share and can actually access.

zh.deck: 识别连接高资源与非高资源语言安全行为的共享安全神经元。
short: 这项工作识别跨语言共享的一小组安全神经元，并通过屏蔽和定向训练检验其作用。这些单元的重叠，连接高资源与非高资源语言的安全行为；SS-Neuron Expansion 将优化集中到承担跨语言桥梁作用的英语安全神经元。
证据同时来自神经元层面的干预和多语言攻击评估，将观察到的语言差异连接到候选内部机制，再检验针对该机制的训练能否改善跨语言安全。
zh.motivation: 同一模型在不同语言上的安全表现可能明显不均衡。理解哪些内部成分参与了安全能力迁移，有助于设计更有针对性的对齐方式。
method: 先定位单语言安全神经元，并通过激活与抑制检验其对安全拒答行为的作用。
识别高资源与非高资源语言之间共享的安全神经元子集，研究其跨语言桥接作用。
结合语言资源分布与模型架构，对选中的共享子集开展神经元定向训练。
zh.evidence: 抑制共享神经元会导致多种非高资源语言的安全性同时下降；强化它们则改善跨语言防御一致性。对该子集进行微调，在所评估设置下优于所比较方法，并维持模型通用能力。
takeaway: 共享模型参数，并不意味着不同语言能够同等有效地访问安全机制。定位迁移桥梁，使这种差异成为具体的研究对象，也为语言覆盖不均衡时如何分配对齐训练提供了依据。
更进一步的方向，是让迁移建立在机制证据之上：先识别共享了什么，再检验增强这些机制是否有益于未被直接监督的语言。迁移质量仍应结合通用帮助性，以及各语言特有的失效模式共同考察。
zh.thesis: 跨语言安全迁移，取决于不同语言共享了哪些机制，以及能否有效调用这些机制。

figures.caption: Figure 2. Pipeline of SS-Neuron expansion for cross-lingual safety alignment. (a) Safety Neuron Identification. (b) Parallel Safety Supervision Construction. We build a parallel safety dataset Dparallel that provides cross-lingual semantic anchors, mapping NHR inputs toward the English safety manifold. papers.authors: Dou Jingtong, Shi Chuancheng, Wang Yemin, Guo Shiming, Yi Anqi, Wu Wenhua, Zhang Li, Shen Fei, Chua Tat-Seng

title.en: DNA: Uncovering Universal Latent Forgery Knowledge
title.zh: DNA：揭示通用的潜在伪造知识

summary.en: Look for forgery-sensitive anchors already encoded in pretrained models instead of relying only on end-to-end adaptation.
summary.zh: 从预训练模型中寻找已有的伪造敏感锚点，为鉴伪提供内部知识依据。

en.deck: Look for forgery-sensitive anchors already encoded in pretrained models instead of relying only on end-to-end adaptation.
short: DNA searches a frozen visual backbone for forgery-discriminative units through a coarse-to-fine procedure. Layer-level geometry narrows the search, while a triadic score and curvature-based selection identify sparse units. A lightweight detector then uses those units to distinguish authentic and synthetic images.

The HIFI-Gen evaluation examines transfer to generators and architectures outside training. This places the emphasis on whether selected representations carry reusable forensic information, beyond the signatures of the generators used to build the detector.
en.motivation: Task-level adaptation can conceal which pretrained components already carry forensic information. The study asks whether a compact set of such components can serve as a detection basis.
method: Analyze feature decoupling and attention shifts to locate critical intermediate layers.
Combine triadic scoring with curvature truncation to select forgery-discriminative units.
Evaluate selected anchors on forgery benchmarks, including the introduced HIFI-Gen dataset.
en.evidence: The paper reports strong few-shot detection and robustness across evaluated architectures and unseen generators. Its experiments examine the usefulness of the selected anchors under distribution changes.
takeaway: The key question in forensics is what survives the next change in generation technology. Internal localization offers a way to investigate that question at the representation level, by examining which discriminative coordinates remain informative when the source of synthetic images changes.

The work suggests a path from pretrained knowledge to a compact, inspectable detection interface. Generalization remains an empirical claim tied to the tested shifts; broader deployment calls for continued evaluation on new generators, processing pipelines, and authentic-image distributions.
en.thesis: Generalizable forgery detection can begin with discriminative structure already present in pretrained features.

zh.deck: 从预训练模型中寻找已有的伪造敏感锚点，为鉴伪提供内部知识依据。
short: DNA 通过由粗到细的过程，在冻结视觉骨干中寻找伪造判别单元。层级几何分析缩小搜索范围，三因素评分与曲率选择进一步定位稀疏单元，再由轻量检测器利用这些单元区分真实与合成图像。
HIFI-Gen 评估关注向训练之外生成器和架构的迁移，检验选出的表征能否承载可复用的取证信息，超越构建检测器时已经见过的生成来源。
zh.motivation: 下游适配可能掩盖预训练模型中原本就存在的鉴伪成分。这项工作研究：是否能定位一组紧凑的内部单元，并将其作为检测的主要依据。
method: 通过特征解耦与注意力分布变化，定位模型关注从全局语义转向局部异常的关键中间层。
结合三因素融合评分与曲率截断策略，筛除语义冗余并选择伪造判别单元。
基于所选锚点开展检测评估，并引入 HIFI-Gen 高保真生成图像基准。
zh.evidence: 论文报告了较强的少样本检测表现，并考察了跨架构与未见生成模型下的稳健性。这些实验用于检验所选内部锚点在分布变化时是否仍具有检测价值。
takeaway: 取证研究的重要问题，是生成技术变化后还剩下哪些可靠信号。内部定位使这一问题能够在表征层面展开：当合成图像的来源改变时，哪些判别坐标仍然有用，它们又依赖哪些视觉统计。
这项工作给出了从预训练知识到紧凑、可检查检测接口的路径。泛化能力仍需由实际分布变化来验证；面向更广泛应用，需要持续覆盖新生成器、后处理流程与真实图像分布。
zh.thesis: 可迁移的伪造检测，可以从预训练特征中已有的判别结构出发。

figures.caption: Figure 3. Overall of the DNA framework. The pipeline operates in a coarse-to-fine manner. Stage 1: layer localization. We pinpoint critical intermediate layers by analyzing feature-space decoupling and attention-distribution shifts, validated by linear probing. Stage 2: FDUs detection. We identify sparse forgery-discriminative units (FDUs) from the frozen backbone using a triadic fusion score (Si,k).

title.zh: 由粗到细的取证搜索

explanation.en: Layer localization and discriminative-unit selection extract a compact interface from the frozen backbone.
explanation.zh: 层定位与判别单元选择，从冻结骨干中提取紧凑的检测接口。

figures.caption: Figure 4. Visualization of distance metrics across layers. The cosine distance (Dcos) between the centroids of real and fake classes at each layer. The euclidean distance (DL2) of the global attention distributions between real and fake images.

title.zh: 类别几何在哪里发生变化？

en.thesis: Multimodal safety needs evaluation across the interaction of language and risk-bearing modality.
short: Lingua-SafetyBench contains 100,440 harmful image–text pairs across ten languages. It explicitly separates image-dominant from text-dominant risks, so evaluation can examine which channel carries the harmful intent instead of conflating all multimodal inputs.

This design reveals an asymmetric safety landscape: high-resource languages and non-high-resource languages do not share the same pattern of vulnerability across risk modalities. Analyses of model scaling and iteration further ask whether average improvements benefit all language groups equally.
en.motivation: Text-only multilingual tests and monolingual multimodal tests leave a gap at their intersection. Image rendering alone also cannot capture the range of semantic interactions between a visual input and an instruction in another language.
method: Construct image–text safety examples with an explicit distinction between image-dominant and text-dominant risks.
Extend the examples across ten languages and evaluate models under a consistent multilingual protocol.
Disaggregate attack success rates by language, risk modality, safety category, and model scale or iteration.
en.evidence: The benchmark analysis includes eleven readily deployable VLLMs and controlled comparisons within the Qwen family. Reported results show substantial variation across languages and an interaction between language-resource level and the dominant risk modality. Scaling improves average safety while leaving uneven gains, particularly for text-dominant non-high-resource settings.
takeaway: A single aggregate safety score can hide which users and input conditions remain poorly protected. Explicitly controlling the language and the source of risk makes those differences measurable and gives alignment work a more specific target.

The broader opportunity is to connect evaluation coverage to mechanisms of access and understanding. A low attack success rate alone does not reveal whether a model recognized the risk or failed to process the input. The benchmark’s factorized design supports further studies that distinguish these explanations.
en.deck: A controlled benchmark separates language coverage from image- and text-dominant risks in multimodal safety evaluation.

zh.thesis: 多模态安全需要在语言与承载风险的输入模态之间，开展交互评估。
short: Lingua-SafetyBench 包含十种语言、100,440 个有害图文对，并明确区分图像主导与文本主导风险。评估因此能够考察有害意图由哪个通道承载，避免将所有多模态输入混在同一个指标中。
这种设计揭示了不对称的安全图景：高资源与非高资源语言，在不同风险模态下呈现不同的脆弱性。针对模型规模与版本迭代的分析，还进一步检验平均安全提升是否同等覆盖不同语言群体。
zh.motivation: 多语言纯文本评估与单语言多模态评估，在两者的交集中留下了空缺。仅将文字渲染成图像，也不足以覆盖视觉内容与另一种语言指令之间的丰富语义交互。
method: 构造图文安全样本，并显式区分图像主导和文本主导的风险来源。
将样本扩展到十种语言，在一致协议下评估模型。
按语言、风险模态、安全类别及模型规模和版本分别分析攻击成功率。
zh.evidence: 分析覆盖十一个可本地部署的 VLLM，并包含 Qwen 系列的受控比较。结果展示显著语言差异，以及语言资源水平与风险主导模态之间的交互；模型扩展改善平均安全，但不同语言群体获得的收益并不均衡。
takeaway: 单一安全均值可能掩盖哪些用户和输入条件仍然缺少保护。显式控制语言与风险来源，使这些差异能够被测量，也为后续对齐提供更具体的目标。
更进一步的方向，是将评估覆盖连接到理解与调用机制。较低的攻击成功率，本身无法说明模型识别了风险，还是没有有效处理输入。基准对不同因素的拆分，为区分这些解释创造了条件。
zh.deck: 通过受控基准区分语言覆盖与图像、文本主导风险，评估多语言多模态安全。

title.en: TraceRouter: Robust Safety for Large Foundation Models via Path-Level Intervention
title.zh: TraceRouter：通过路径级干预提升基础模型安全性

summary.en: Follow the cross-layer propagation of harmful semantics and intervene at the pathway level.
summary.zh: 追踪有害语义的跨层传播，并在路径层面进行干预。

en.deck: Follow the cross-layer propagation of harmful semantics and intervene at the pathway level.
short: TraceRouter studies safety through paths connecting internal components. It localizes sensitive onset layers, uses sparse features to trace relevant attention interactions, and applies path-level suppression through a focused intervention. The goal is to interrupt the information flow associated with unsafe behavior while preserving general model utility.

The work evaluates both diffusion and language models, pairing safety measurements with quality or utility measurements. Its analysis shifts attention from where a feature exists to how that feature participates in downstream computation.
en.motivation: Distributed harmful computation can continue through multiple layers even when a local feature is suppressed. A defence therefore needs to examine how the information propagates.
method: Locate a sensitive onset layer through attention-divergence analysis.
Use SAEs and differential activations to isolate malicious features.
Estimate feature influence with zero-out interventions and suppress selected downstream pathways.
en.evidence: Reported comparisons examine adversarial robustness together with general utility. The results support the value of tracing and suppressing selected propagation pathways rather than treating safety as a purely local feature intervention.
takeaway: This gives interpretability a more relational target. Two components can matter because of the route linking them, even when neither isolated component fully explains the behavior. Tracing that route can make an intervention more specific about where and how it acts.

The practical challenge is selectivity across tasks and model families. Path-level evidence offers a way to reason about that selectivity, while the reported evaluations define the settings in which suppressing the selected routes improves safety with limited utility loss.
en.thesis: A behavior can depend on a route through the network, making information flow a useful unit of intervention.

zh.deck: 追踪有害语义的跨层传播，并在路径层面进行干预。
short: TraceRouter 从内部成分之间的路径研究模型安全。它定位敏感起始层，通过稀疏特征追踪相关注意力交互，再实施聚焦于路径的抑制，尝试阻断与不安全行为相关的信息流，同时保留一般能力。
工作覆盖扩散与语言模型，将安全指标与质量或有用性指标配对评估。分析的重心由特征存在于哪里，进一步延伸到该特征如何参与下游计算。
zh.motivation: 有害计算可能以分布式方式跨层传播。即使抑制了局部特征，相关信息仍可能沿其他连接继续传递，因此需要进一步分析其传播过程。
method: 通过注意力差异分析定位敏感的起始层。
利用 SAE 和差分激活分析分离与有害语义相关的特征。
通过置零干预估计特征影响得分，映射下游因果路径，并选择性抑制相关传播链。
zh.evidence: 论文在对抗鲁棒性与通用效用之间开展联合评估。所报告结果支持追踪并抑制选定传播路径的价值，说明安全干预还需要考察特征之间的跨层连接。
takeaway: 这一视角为可解释性增加了关系层面的研究对象。两个成分可能因为相互连接的计算路线而重要，单独观察其中任何一个都不足以描述行为。追踪路线，有助于让干预更具体地说明作用位置与作用方式。
实际挑战仍是跨任务、跨模型家族的选择性。路径证据为理解这种选择性提供了依据，而论文中的评估刻画了在什么设置下，抑制选定路径能够改善安全，并控制对一般能力的影响。

title.en: Where Culture Fades: Revealing the Cultural Gap in Text-to-Image Generation
title.zh: 文化在哪里消退？揭示文生图中的文化差距

summary.en: A model may contain cultural knowledge yet fail to activate it when generating images from multilingual prompts.
summary.zh: 模型可能已经具备文化知识，却未能在多语言文生图过程中充分激活它。

en.deck: A model may contain cultural knowledge yet fail to activate it when generating images from multilingual prompts.
short: Where Culture Fades investigates under-activation of cultural representations in text-to-image models. It traces where cultural information weakens, identifies sparse culture-related neurons, and tests inference-time activation and targeted enhancement. CultureBench connects these internal analyses to the cultural fidelity of generated images.

The study distinguishes possessing a representation from successfully expressing it. It examines whether changing the activation of existing knowledge can improve culture-specific generation while tracking generation quality and diversity.
en.motivation: Visual realism and semantic alignment do not ensure that images preserve the cultural connotations of a prompt across languages.
method: Analyze cultural consistency under multilingual prompts in representative text-to-image models.
Probe a small set of culture-sensitive neurons concentrated in selected layers.
Amplify selected neurons at inference time or update only culturally relevant layers.
en.evidence: Analyses of two representative models support under-activation rather than simply missing knowledge. CultureBench evaluations report improved cultural consistency while preserving fidelity and diversity.
takeaway: This distinction matters whenever a model’s output is used to judge the scope of its knowledge. A generic image may reflect weak access to cultural detail, incomplete knowledge, or both. Internal analysis makes those explanations more separable and enables a more specific intervention.

The broader goal is culturally faithful generation grounded in identifiable mechanisms and measured outcomes. The reported findings establish a direction within the tested models and cultural coverage, while richer local evaluation remains essential for understanding what fidelity means across communities.
en.thesis: Cultural knowledge can be present in a model yet fail to shape what it generates.

zh.deck: 模型可能已经具备文化知识，却未能在多语言文生图过程中充分激活它。
short: Where Culture Fades 研究文生图模型中文化表征激活不足的问题。工作追踪文化信息在哪里减弱，识别稀疏的文化相关神经元，并检验推理时激活与定向增强；CultureBench 则将内部分析连接到生成图像的文化忠实度。
研究区分了拥有表征与成功表达表征，考察调用已有知识是否能够改善特定文化的生成表现，同时追踪生成质量与多样性。
zh.motivation: 视觉逼真与语义对齐，并不自动意味着模型能够保留不同语言提示所承载的文化内涵。文化一致性需要被单独定义和检验。
method: 在代表性文生图模型中，分析多语言提示下的文化一致性与偏向。
通过探测方法，将文化敏感信号定位到少数固定层中的一小组神经元。
在推理阶段增强选中神经元，或仅更新与文化相关的层，形成两种互补的对齐策略。
zh.evidence: 对两个代表性模型的分析支持了文化表示激活不足这一解释。CultureBench 上的评估报告了文化一致性的改善，同时考察并保留图像保真度与多样性。
takeaway: 当我们通过输出判断模型知道多少时，这一区分尤其重要。泛化、缺少文化细节的图像，可能来自知识调用不足，也可能来自知识缺失，或两者共同作用。内部分析有助于拆分这些解释，并提出更具体的干预。
更广泛的目标，是让文化忠实生成同时具有可识别的内部机制与可衡量的外部结果。论文在所测试的模型和文化覆盖范围内提供了证据；面对不同社区，仍需要更丰富的在地评估，理解文化忠实度的具体内涵。
zh.thesis: 文化知识可能已经存在于模型中，却没有充分参与最终图像的生成。
